title: Master Data Engineer
description:
*Vi är Strawberry. Ett växande universum med hundratals hotell, restauranger, spa och upplevelser i hela Norden, Litauen och på Färöarna. Här ryms urbana Comfort Hotel™, varma Quality Hotel™, stilfulla Clarion Hotel®, hemtrevliga Home Hotel och vägnära Stopover – tillsammans med en stor samling unika och fristående hotell. På sina hotellvistelser samlar våra gäster dessutom Spenn – flexibla poäng att använda till nya upplevelser. Bakom allt står tiotusentals människor från hela världen, med energi, mod och entusiasm.*




 At Strawberry, we're not just a hotel company - we're building a universe of experiences. We're transforming the hospitality landscape through innovation and technology, and 2023 marked a major milestone with the launch of our new mother brand, Strawberry. This exciting evolution creates countless opportunities for growth and impact. We're on a journey to become a truly data-driven organization, fostering a culture where decisions are informed by diverse perspectives and trusted data.
   

  

**Are you ready to be at the core of Strawberry's data transformation? At Strawberry, we're creating a better world with Energy, Courage, and Excitement - and it all starts with trusted, high-quality data.**
 As our
 **Master Data Engineer** 
 , you will join our central Master Data Management team, placing you at the heart of everything that happens within our company. You will be designing and building the master data solutions that ensure accuracy, consistency, and trust across all our systems. By transforming business needs into reliable data models, you will empower better decision-making and drive our success story forward.
   

  





  

  

  





 What You'll Do:
 


* Design, build, and maintain scalable master data solutions on our MDM platform, supporting complex data flows and dependencies across a large, multi-system organization
* Partner with key stakeholders to guide how master data is structured, governed, and shared across the organization, balancing business needs with technical scalability
* Translate business needs into robust technical designs and data models that deliver measurable value.
* Build solutions that enable accurate and consistent master data across enterprise systems, centralizing critical information and streamlining integrations to support business growth.
* Act as a trusted bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring solutions align with business priorities while maintaining speed, clarity, and quality in delivery.
* Proactively identify and resolve issues affecting performance or data quality, keeping the MDM platform secure, efficient, and dependable.
* Explore and apply AI and automation to improve data quality, matching, enrichment and efficiency across master data processes.
* Foster a culture of open feedback and collaboration, driving continuous improvement in both our solutions and how the team works together.



 What You'll Bring:
 


* A genuine interest in how master data shapes business operations, from ensuring accuracy and consistency to designing processes that make information reliable, accessible, and valuable enterprise-wide.
* Proven ability to design and develop scalable Master data solutions, from conceptual design through to physical implementation, ideally within large, complex, multi-stakeholder organizations.
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences and vice versa.
* A structured, solution-oriented mindset paired with strong interpersonal skills and genuine ease operating across organizational boundaries.
* Demonstrated experience driving technical initiatives across multiple teams and departments in complex organizations.
* Strong influencing skills and the confidence to contribute to cross-department discussions on master data ownership and governance, bridging business needs and technical execution.



 What You'll Need:
 


* Strong experience with databases for designing and maintaining high-quality structured data
* Hands-on experience with GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
* Solid, handson experience with Master Data Management, including data modeling.
* A solid understanding of integration patterns and best practices for connecting enterprise systems, ensuring reliable data exchange and synchronization across platforms, particularly within complex, multi-system landscapes.
* Proficiency in Java development for building reliable, scalable solutions.
* Experience with modern software engineering practices, including automated testing, CI/CD and API-driven development.
* Familiarity with TIBCO EBX or similar enterprise MDM platforms is a strong advantage.



  

  

  





**What We Offer:**




**Real Impact:** 
 Be a part of a dynamic transformation and contribute directly to our success story.
   

  

  





**Empowerment:** 
 Work in a flat organization with trust, autonomy, and the opportunity to make a real difference.
   

  

  





**Growth & Development:** 
 Access professional development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career.
   

  

  





**Fun & Community:** 
 Enjoy a vibrant work environment with plenty of social events and team-building activities.
   

  

  





**Fantastic Perks:** 
 Benefit from great employee discounts, including staff and friends & family rates at our hotels.
   

  

  





**Flexible Work:** 
 Enjoy the best of both worlds with our hybrid model, with three days of in-person collaboration at our Oslo or Stockholm HQ.
   

  

 We do not offer remote positions; candidates must be located in or willing to relocate to Oslo or Stockholm.
   

  

**Ready to shape the future of hospitality? Apply today – interviews are ongoing!**

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
**Want to build the event platform that powers hotel operations around the world?**
 Every day, hotel staff rely on accurate, real-time information to issue access, investigate incidents, manage devices, and keep operations running smoothly. At ASSA ABLOY Opening Solutions in Stockholm, Sweden, our Event Hub team owns the platform that collects, processes, and delivers these events across the Vostio ecosystem.
   

  

 We are looking for you, who wants to work close to the product, take ownership of a business-critical domain, and build distributed systems used by hotels around the globe. This is an opportunity to make a real impact while working in a collaborative environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous development.
   

  

**What You Would Do As Our Senior Backend Developer**
 You would help design, build, and evolve a scalable event-driven platform. Your work will span architecture, software development, production operations, and continuous improvement, giving you the opportunity to influence both the technical direction and long-term success of a critical product area. This is not a role where you own a small service hidden deep within a large organisation. You would join a small, high-impact team responsible for a core product domain that powers how operational events are captured, processed, audited, and delivered across Vostio.The Event Hub team builds and operates the services, APIs, and event infrastructure that help hotels, partners, and internal teams understand what is happening across access management, devices, and connected systems. The team is responsible for event APIs used by customers, partners, and internal teams, as well as event streaming, subscription, and integration capabilities across the Vostio platform.
   

  

 You would also:
   

  

* Build event-driven backend systems — Design and develop Java services that collect, process and distribute operational events from hotels, devices and access systems.
* Own APIs and integrations — Create APIs, subscriptions and integration capabilities that let customers and partners automate workflows and consume operational data.
* Design cloud-native solutions on AWS — Work primarily with Java and with scalable, resilient cloud services using modern AWS patterns, CI/CD and operational practices.
* Shape the technical direction — Influence architecture, challenge assumptions and help define how the Event Hub domain evolves over time.
* Take responsibility beyond coding — You would be involved in design discussions, production support, roadmap input and technical strategy.


**The Skills And Experience You Need**
 We are looking for someone with:
   

  

* Experience building backend systems in Java and delivering solutions from idea to production.
* Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating scalable solutions on AWS.
* Experience with event-driven, distributed, and integration-heavy systems, including strong API design skills.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and modern software engineering practices, combined with a pragmatic engineering mindset.
* The ability to simplify complex technical problems, communicate clearly, and take ownership of outcomes.


 Nice to have: Kotlin, Go, Kafka, SNS/SQS, EventBridge or similar technologies; experience with SaaS platforms, IoT, telemetry, or operational data platforms.
   

  

**Why developers join and stay**
* Small team, big impact, every engineer has meaningful influence on architecture, priorities and technical direction.
* Real engineering challenges, you will build systems that process and distribute operational events across a global hospitality platform, balancing scalability, reliability and usability.
* Modern technology stack, the core of the role is Java, AWS, event-driven architecture, cloud-native services and modern engineering practices.
* Product mindset, we build for the long term. Teams have ownership, direct access to stakeholders and the freedom to make good technical decisions.
* Stockholm-based team with global reach, the systems you build are used by hotels around the world every day.


**What We Offer**
 We’re passionate about providing amazing opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer:
   

  

* Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills.
* A competitive salary and benefits package.
* A dynamic and inclusive work environment.
* The chance to make a meaningful impact in attracting and retaining top talent.


**We review applications regularly, so don't wait**
 We are building diverse, inclusive teams and encourage applications from everyone who can see themselves working with us. Just set up your profile and apply here.
   

  

 To make sure your personal data is safe, we don’t look at any applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, email Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner lea.rein@assaabloy.com
   

  

 Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening will need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subject to background screening. The performance of background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.
   

  

 Let’s create a safer and more open world - together!
   

  

 To find out more about us, visit www.assaabloy.com
   

  

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
 Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
   

  

 As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.
   

  

 As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: AI Service Owner / AI Solution Developer,
description:

 Do you enjoy taking validated ideas and turning them into robust, production-ready solutions?
 



 Do you thrive in building AI tools, agents, and automations that people rely on every day?

You will work close to the Emerging Technologies function, which drives ideation, exploration, and early validation, while you focus on execution, productization, and lifecycle management.

* Competitive compensation, pension, and bonus
* Food allowance and a wide range of employee benefits
* A collaborative, high-performing culture
* Opportunities to grow within the Nordics and across the broader McDonald’s ecosystem



**Who You Are** 




 You are a builder at heart.
 



 You enjoy taking something that works in theory and making it work reliably in reality. You are comfortable working from partially defined inputs and know how to create structure, momentum, and outcomes.
 



 You combine
 **technical execution with product thinking** 
 , and you care about both how solutions are built and how they perform over time.
 



**We believe you:** 



* Have hands-on experience building AI solutions, agents, automations, or internal tools
* Have worked with modern AI platforms and tooling, such as n8n, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, OpenAI or similar
* Have experience integrating AI solutions with APIs and business systems
* Are comfortable taking a solution from requirements or PoC to production and ongoing management
* Have experience with product ownership, including backlog management and iterative development
* Are skilled in creating practical, scalable, and maintainable solutions
* Thrive in environments where execution, speed, and quality must be balanced



  





**It is a strong plus if you also have:** 



* Experience with AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices
* Familiarity with cloud-based AI services and architectures
* Experience with lightweight scripting (e.g., Python, JavaScript)
* working in retail, QSR, or multi-unit environments
* Collaborating across product, engineering, and business teams



  





**Interested?** 




 Curious? Even if you’re not actively looking, we welcome confidential conversations, reach out and we’ll tell you more.
 



 This is a Nordic role with flexibility in where you are based. The position can be based in Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen, or Helsinki. As this is a cross-Nordic role, some travel should be expected.
 



 In this recruitment process, McDonald's / Food Folk is partnering with Aliby – The Pink Company.
 



 As interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For questions, please contact: Lars Ohlson at +46 70 588 81 75 or
 
 lars.ohlson@aliby.se
 




  





**About McDonald’s & Food Folk** 




 McDonald's is the largest restaurant chain in the Nordics, serving iconic products like the Big Mac® and world-famous fries to 600,000 guests every day. With more than 430 restaurants and approximately 20,000 employees, McDonald’s delivers great restaurant experiences across the region.
 



 Since 2017, Food Folk has held the license rights for McDonald’s in the Nordics and is responsible for developing the brand across these markets. The Nordic headquarters organization consists of around 220 colleagues working across group functions in a matrix structure.
 



 Food Folk is the largest youth employer in the region, with around 20,000 restaurant employees and approximately 70 franchisees operating across four countries. There are ambitious plans to grow to 600 restaurants by 2030.
 



 With a strong high-performance culture, a focus on sustainability, and a commitment to making a positive impact in the communities we serve, Food Folk continues to shape the future of McDonald’s across the Nordics.

title: Experienced Software Engineer
description:
**The team:** 




 The development team is based in Stockholm. It consists of highly skilled and helpful individuals with diverse backgrounds, each engineer playing a unique part in serving our global customer base. We value learning from and supporting each other in order to benefit from our different strengths and experiences. We are strong believers that collaboration is key to innovation and to produce a user experience and a technical solution that we can be proud of.

 We are at the heart of the global financial system, dedicated to building the future of post-trade processing. Our products within the Trade Lifecycle division cover many of these areas, such as portfolio reconciliation, risk calculations, collateral management, and settlement automation. Improving these systems has a real impact on reducing the systemic risk of the global financial market while boosting operational efficiency and producing cost savings for many of the largest banks in the world.
 



  





 As an experienced software engineer, you are responsible for:

* Design and evaluate new architecture principles
* Continuously look for opportunities to improve our tools and our ways of working
* Be part of the team taking care of the overall system health
* Mentoring of colleagues

**Fundamental requirement:** 



* More than 10 years of relevant experience
* Excellent communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to drive bigger initiatives independently and with the team
* An aptitude and willingness to improve yourself, others around you, and our ways of working
* Someone who will work from the office at least 3 days per week



  





**Additional preferred requirements:** 



* An interest in financial markets



  





**The location: Stockholm, Sweden** 




  





**Right to work requirements:** 




 This role is limited to persons with right to work in the Sweden.
 



  





**Our Benefits: Global vision, local impact** 




 At OSTTRA, our benefits philosophy offers a market-competitive package that reflects our position as an industry leader. We want to ensure you feel valued, secure, and empowered wherever you are in the world.
 



 Our approach is built on three core pillars:
 


* **Global foundations** 
 : We provide a baseline of excellence across all our offices, focusing on comprehensive Health & Wellness, Financial Security, and Work-Life Balance. No matter your location, you are part of a culture that prioritizes your holistic well-being.

 We empower you to work in a way that suits your life. This includes a hybrid working model, generous leave policies, and a commitment to your continuous professional development.

 Every employee at OSTTRA is an owner, and a member of The Trust, our employee ownership programme. Our distinct culture encourages colleagues to think and act like owners and raise the bar constantly.
 



 This plan reflects our belief that when we work together to build a stronger, more valuable organisation, then all colleagues should benefit from the value we create.
 



  





**About OSTTRA** 




 We build and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post-trade financial system runs on. Launched in 2021, we have unified more than 20 years of heritage and expertise from four industry leaders into a single, integrated business.
 



 Today,we operate a trusted network that connects thousands of market participants to streamline end-to-end workflows, from trade capture through portfolio optimisation.We translate industry change into workable process, engineering an open, intelligent ecosystem that removes friction and reduces risk for the global markets.
 



  





 Our distinct ownership culture is underpinned by four behaviours: boldness, curiosity, accountability, and collaboration. In 2025 we were acquired by KKR, one of the world’s most successful private equity firms, and are on a journey of growth and impact.
 



 Joining our team now is a unique opportunity - you will help to shape the next generation of post-trade, transform shared infrastructure into shared benefit, and accelerate your own career. Learn more at
 
 www.osttra.com
 
 .
 



  





**Equal opportunity employer statement at OSTTRA:**




 We are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all colleagues have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasise fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain the best talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post-trade financial system runs on.

 är ett världsledande globalt e-hälsobolag med 9 300 anställda och lokala kontor i 18 länder. Med över 1,6 miljoner användare i 60 länder är vi en global aktör med stark lokal närvaro.
 



  





 Genom våra kompetenta medarbetare kan vi erbjuda högkvalitativa lösningar inom e-hälsa. CGM har funnits på den svenska e-hälsomarknaden i nära 40 år och levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar till såväl enskilda mottagningar som till kliniker, sjukhus, privata vårdgivare, kommuner och regioner. Vi utvecklar bland annat
 **TakeCare** 
 , ett av Sveriges största journalsystem med över 70 000 användare och omkring 7 miljoner patientjournaler. Alla produkter och tjänster utvecklas i nära samarbete med vårdens verksamhet och vår målsättning är att på ett användarvänligt och effektivt sätt stödja en patients hela vårdkedja.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Vi söker nu fullstackutvecklare till teamet bakom TakeCare. Här får du arbeta med avancerad systemutveckling där kvalitet, stabilitet och smart problemlösning står i fokus.
 



  





 Du kommer främst att utveckla i
 **C#** 
 och
 **Dyalog/APL** 
 . Erfarenhet av APL är inget krav – vi lär dig. Det viktiga är att du är nyfiken, tycker om att lära dig nya tekniker och gillar att lösa komplexa problem. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med teknik som används varje dag inom svensk sjukvård och som har en direkt påverkan på människors liv.
 



  





**Vem är du** 




 Vi tror att du har:
 


* Flerårig erfarenhet av utveckling i C# eller annat modernt högnivåspråk.
* Relevant akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* Erfarenhet av teknisk design och systemutveckling.
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.



  





 Det är meriterande om du har arbetat med Python, Haskell, MATLAB, R eller andra funktionella eller arrayorienterade språk. Det är även meriterande om du har erfarenhet av någon typ av molnlösning.
 



  





 Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och tycker om att lära dig nya saker. Du ser AI-verktyg som en naturlig del av utvecklingsarbetet och motiveras av att skapa lösningar som gör verklig samhällsnytta.
 



  





**Vi erbjuder** 




 Hos oss hittar du ett tryggt och erfaret utvecklingsteam där fokus ligger på att lösa komplexa problem tillsammans. Vi är prestigelösa, hjälpsamma och tror på att bra lösningar skapas genom samarbete. Vi erbjuder bland annat:
 



  




* En roll där ditt arbete bidrar till en bättre och säkrare vård.
* Möjlighet att lära dig Dyalog/APL.
* Sex veckors semester.
* Generöst friskvårdsbidrag samt 1 friskvårdstimme i veckan.
* Hybridupplägg som inkluderar minst tre dagar på kontoret och möjlighet till två dagar på distans per vecka.
* Modernt kontor vid Solna station.
* Tillsvidareanställning på heltid med sex månaders provanställning.
* Kollektivavtal.



  





**Kontakt** 




 Låter det intressant? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan!
 



  





 För denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Ants Tech Recruiters. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Laura Sonnert, TA Partner, på laura.sonnert@ants.se.
 



  





  





*CGMs vision ”Synchronizing healthcare” genomsyrar allt vårt arbete. Vi är marknadsledande leverantör av IT-lösningar och kommunikationstjänster inom hälso- och sjukvård, social omsorg, företagshälsovård, barn- och elevhälsovård samt kliniska laboratorium i Sverige. Vår drivkraft är att göra nytta för patienten via våra e-hälsolösningar. Behovet av nya lösningar är under ständig utveckling, vilket ställer höga krav på oss som leverantör. Tillsammans med våra kunder är vi starkt engagerade i att förverkliga Sveriges e-hälsovision om att bli bäst i världen på att använda digitaliseringens och e-hälsans möjligheter.*

title: Integrationsspecialist
description:
**Om tjänsten**
**Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens digitala plattform för en av Nordens ledande installations- och serviceaktörer?**
 Bravida söker nu en Integrationsspecialist till Integration & Digital Automation inom Business Technology. Hos oss får du en central roll i att utveckla, förvalta och modernisera integrationslösningar som kopplar samman affärssystem, molntjänster, dataflöden och automationer i en komplex nordisk verksamhet.
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett team som ansvarar för integrationsplattformen och många av de mest affärskritiska informationsflödena inom Bravida. Samtidigt får du möjlighet att bidra till vår fortsatta satsning inom automation, AI och digitalisering.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Integrationsspecialist arbetar du nära verksamheten, Solution Owners, utvecklare, arkitekter och externa leverantörer. Du blir en av nyckelpersonerna bakom Bravidas integrationslandskap och bidrar både till den dagliga leveransen och till utvecklingen av framtidens lösningar.
   

  

 Rollen spänner över hela livscykeln – från kravdialog och lösningsdesign till utveckling, implementation och förvaltning. Du hjälper verksamheten att omvandla behov och idéer till stabila, säkra och skalbara lösningar som skapar konkret affärsvärde.
   

  

**Exempel på vad du kommer att arbeta med**
* Design och utveckling av integrationer mellan affärssystem, SaaS-plattformar och andra lösningar
* API-utveckling och API Management
* Integrationer via moderna integrationsplattformar
* Felsökning och analys av komplexa integrationsproblem
* Automatisering av affärsprocesser och informationsflöden
* Kravhantering, testning och kvalitetssäkring
* Dialog med verksamhet, leverantörer och externa partners
* Förbättringsinitiativ inom digitalisering, AI och automation
* Bidra till utvecklingen av Bravidas integrationsarkitektur


**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig är nyfiken, analytisk och gillar att förstå både detaljerna och helheten. Du drivs av att lösa problem, förbättra arbetssätt och skapa värde genom smart användning av digitala lösningar.
   

  

 Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande områden:
   

  

* Systemintegration
* API:er och integrationsplattformar
* Microsoft Azure (Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management)
* Eventdriven arkitektur
* Kravhantering och test
* Informationsflöden och dataintegration
* Support och felsökning i verksamhetskritiska system
* Samarbete med verksamhet, leverantörer och andra intressenter


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av**
* Systemutveckling
* C#
* Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry)
* DevOps och CI/CD
* AI- och automationslösningar
* ERP-, HR- eller andra affärssystemintegrationer


 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du kunna göra tekniska frågeställningar begripliga för olika målgrupper och ha förmågan att utvärdera mellan arkitekturella principer och praktiskt genomförande.
   

  

**Bravida som arbetsgivare**
 På Bravida är vi stolta över att leverera känslan när allt bara fungerar. Våra medarbetare har byggt förtroende hos våra kunder sedan 1922 och är hjärtat i vår organisation. Tillsammans levererar vi de mest energieffektiva tekniska lösningarna. Hos oss har du möjlighet att göra skillnad för en mer hållbar framtid. Vi värdesätter mångfald och strävar efter att skapa en säker och inkluderande arbetsplats där alla känner sig välkomna och uppskattade. Din säkerhet kommer först, alltid.
   

  

 Genom våra interna utbildningar erbjuder vi utvecklingsmöjligheter, och i vår starka gemenskap hjälper vi varandra att lyckas. Som en del av vårt team får du chansen att utvecklas både personligt och professionellt. Vi är stolta över att vara ett av Nordens ledande företag inom vår bransch, vilket ger oss möjlighet att erbjuda förmåner som exempelvis förmånliga pensionsavtal, friskvårdsbidrag och vidareutbildning. Läs mer om hur det är att arbeta på Bravida här.
   

  

**Hur söker jag jobbet?**
 Ansökningar hanteras löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum som är
 **2026-09-18** 
 . Du skickar in ditt CV och personliga brev genom att klicka på knappen Ansök nedan.
   

  

 Praktisk information:
   

  

* Omfattning: Heltid, tillsvidare (inledande provanställning 6 månader)
* Rapporterar till: Head of Integration & Digital Automation
* Kontakt: Vid frågor om tjänsten, kontakta Simin Liu, Head of Integration & Digital Automation

title: Staff Engineer | Consumer Domain
description:
**We're building tomorrow's delivery platform**
 At Instabee, we're on a mission to become the undisputed #1 delivery service in the eyes of our consumers. We need exceptional engineers to help us get there.
   

  

 We're looking for a Staff Engineer who can bridge the gap between ambitious business goals and technical execution. Someone who identifies opportunities, builds the right solutions, and raises the bar for everyone around them.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 You will be embedded in one of our Consumer teams, the part of Instabee that sits closest to real users and real deliveries. This is a hands-on role where you will spend most of your time building, not reviewing architectural slide decks. Your job is ensuring we're building the right things, in the right way, at the right scale.
   

  

 Aside from the work within the team, you will be part of a community of Staff Engineers working on cross-organisation projects and challenges.
   

  

 You'll help translate business ambition into engineering execution, surface hard problems before they become expensive ones, and actively drive the engineering culture at Instabee by raising the bar, sharing knowledge, and making the organisation better at building software.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

**Ship things users notice** 
 Identify and build features that move the needle on user satisfaction. You'll own problems from idea to production, together with your team.
   

  

**Keep the team unblocked** 
 Spot friction before it becomes a bottleneck. That might mean improving test setup, fixing a flaky deploy pipeline, or untangling a service boundary that's slowing everyone down.
   

  

**Make technical trade-offs explicit** 
 Help the team choose solutions that are good enough now and don't paint us into a corner later. Scale and velocity both matter, and your job is to hold both at once.
   

  

**Connect code to outcomes** 
 Help engineers understand why what they're building matters. Work with Product and Data to make sure our systems produce the signals we need to make good decisions.
   

  

**Raise the bar around you** 
 Coach engineers, share what you know, and push for a culture where we learn from mistakes instead of hiding them.
   

  

 What we're looking for
   

  

 You don't need to be an expert in everything your team touches, but you should care deeply about succeeding together as a team.
   

  

**You're a doer.** 
 You don't just think about problems; you solve them.
   

  

**You're a technical leader** 
 who has built web and app (ideally consumer facing) solutions at scale, and can move fluidly between deep technical dives and high-level architectural trade-offs.
   

  

**You're strategic and pragmatic.** 
 You know that perfect is the enemy of good. You favor iteration, deliver value early and often, and ship before you have the ideal solution.
   

  

**You're a communicator and collaborator.** 
 You make complex technical concepts accessible to non-technical partners and thrive in cross-functional environments where engineering, product, and business move together.
   

  

**You're a quality advocate** 
 who holds a high bar for stability and security, without killing the pace of innovation.
   

  

 If this sounds like the kind of challenge you'd wake up excited to tackle, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 What You'll Get
   

  

 We can promise you'll be challenged, develop your skills, and work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like change and want to set new processes and ways of working — this is the place for you.
   

  

 Of course, we have all the standard benefits in place. But beyond that, we also offer:
   

  

**🌇 Sky-High Office —** 
 Modern and newly renovated with 360-degree views across Stockholm
   

  

**🐶 Puppy Friendly —** 
 Bring your dog to work (we've got a whole floor for our furry friends)
   

  

**🏓 Fun & Games —** 
 Ping pong, shuffleboard, foosball, and a karaoke room
   

  

**👶 Six Months Parental Pay —** 
 Step away and give your little one the care they deserve
   

  

**🎂 Your Birthday Off —** 
 Celebrate yourself with a day off each year
   

  

**⏰ Hybrid & Flexible —** 
 Work the way that works for you
   

  

 Our Commitment to You
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion are at the heart of who we are. We're committed to creating an inclusive work environment where everyone's perspectives are valued and every employee has the opportunity to thrive and reach their full potential.
   

  

 Next Steps
   

  

*This role requires a background check via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys, which includes a review of public criminal records. The results are handled confidentially as part of our standard recruitment process in Sweden.*
 Ready to join us? We'd love to hear how you think about technical leadership and what excites you about solving logistics at scale.
   

  

 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**ABOUT SINCH** 




 Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.
 



 Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.
 



 At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!
 



  





  





**About the Team** 




 Chatlayer Product is made up of two teams — Platform & Integration and Flow Engine & Intelligence Integration — sharing a single product roadmap and backlog under Engineering Manager JR Reynolds. Together the organization includes around 10 engineers, two tech leads, a product manager, and a UX designer. The teams value honesty, growth, knowledge sharing, collaboration, ownership, and “being pirates” — a bias toward bold, resourceful action. Communication happens primarily through Slack and Teams, and we have a strong culture of transparent decision-making and discoverable collaboration.
 



  





**Where We’re Heading** 




 Chatlayer is building toward a future of conversations with control — where AI agents and deterministic workflows work in harmony to solve our customers’ problems. This means evolving from a traditional chatbot platform into an agentic orchestration system where intelligent automation is grounded by reliable, predictable flow execution. We’re looking for the right people to help us get there.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help design, build, and scale Chatlayer’s conversational AI platform. You will work across a real-time, distributed system that handles text and voice interactions at scale — including WebSocket infrastructure, bot engine integrations, and platform services. This role requires someone who is comfortable operating in ambiguity, can drive technical decisions, and thrives in a team that ships with urgency while investing in system health.
 



 Candidates should bring a knowledgeable and skilled approach to the use of AI in the software development process itself — we value a balanced, curious, and quality-driven use of AI tooling. We’re not looking for engineers who blindly generate code or who refuse to adopt new tools; we want people who apply AI judiciously, maintaining deep comprehension of what they build while leveraging these tools to move faster and think bigger.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design and build backend services supporting Chatlayer’s text and voice channels, including WebSocket servers and real-time communication infrastructure
* Work on platform integrations and app-integration frameworks
* Contribute to architectural evolution — decoupling legacy dependencies and building more modular, vendor-agnostic systems
* Participate in technical decisions around identity management (SinchID), distributed events and data processing (MongoDB Atlas, Kafka, Temporal), and new platform capabilities
* Lead code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions within the team
* Mentor and be mentored by other engineers and contribute to a strong engineering culture rooted in the team’s values
* Support production systems through on-call rotations and incident response
* Invest in system health — improving test coverage, addressing technical debt, and continuously improving operational processes (Kaizen)



  





  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




**Required Skills & Experience** 



* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Strong proficiency in Node.js/TypeScript and/or Go
* Experience with real-time systems — WebSocket, event-driven architectures, or similar
* Solid understanding and hands-on experience with complex cloud infrastructure, ideally GCP and/or AWS
* Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems, including state management across replicas (e.g., ETCD, Redis)
* Working knowledge of MongoDB or similar document databases
* Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures (ideally Kafka specifically)
* Strong system design fundamentals — can reason about scalability, latency, failover, and trade-offs
* Excellent communication skills and comfort working in a distributed, cross-functional team (CET timezone alignment preferred)



  





**Preferred / Nice-to-Have** 



* Experience with conversational AI, chatbot/voicebot platforms, or NLP/NLU pipelines
* Experience with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with identity management systems (OAuth/OIDC)
* Prior experience in a CPaaS, scale-up, or fast-growth product company



 Our corporate language is English; please submit your application in English.
 



  





**OUR HIRING PROCESS** 




 We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.
 



 We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn’t what you’re looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page:
 
 https://www.sinch.com/careers/
 
 . No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward — hopefully with us!

title: PLATFORM ENGINEER TILL BANKGIROT
description:
**Vill du vara med och bygga en modern, container- och tooling-plattform som Sveriges betalflöden är beroende av – varje dag, i alla lägen?** 
**Hos Bankgirot får du arbeta med grunden för en modern och samhällsviktig betalinfrastruktur.**
 Bankgirot har sedan 1959 stått för den tekniska strukturen som binder samman Sveriges banker och säkerställer att betalningar fungerar tryggt och effektivt. Organisationen befinner sig i en omfattande modernisering där dagens system förvaltas parallellt med utvecklingen av en framtidssäkrad betalinfrastruktur med höga krav på säkerhet, stabilitet och tillgänglighet.
   

  

 Efter att ha stärkt teamet med två Platform Engineers söker Bankgirot nu en senior Platform Engineer som vill ta en nyckelroll i den fortsatta utvecklingen av den moderna container- och toolingplattform som utgör grunden för Sveriges framtida betalinfrastruktur.
   

  

 Hos Bankgirot får du
   

  

* Vara med och bygga en modern, open source-baserad plattform som är avgörande för Sveriges betalflöden
* Arbeta i gränslandet mellan infrastruktur, utveckling, säkerhet med cloud native-teknik
* Påverka arbetssätt, teknikval och arkitektur i en plattform ständigt under uppbyggnad
* Vara en del av en samhällsviktig verksamhet med höga krav på tillgänglighet, stabilitet och säkerhet


 Om rollen
   

  

 Som Platform Engineer ingår du i teamet
 **Cloud, Container, Platform & Tooling** 
 . Rollen innebär arbete i en redan produktionssatt plattform som utvecklas vidare mot en mer mogen, robust och lättkonsumerad lösning. Bankgirot äger och driftar själv sina plattformskomponenter, vilket ger stort ansvar och möjlighet att påverka helheten. Du kommer att få arbeta i en modern teknikmiljö som inkluderar bland annat en containerplattform baserat på vanilla kubernetes omgiven av en service mesh, samt tooling bestående av GitLab, ArgoCD och Jfrog Artifactory & Xray.
   

  

**I rollen ingår att:**
* Designa, drifta och vidareutveckla containerplattformen, både on‑prem och i cloud
* Automatisera plattforms- och driftprocesser samt vidareutveckla CI/CD- och GitOps‑flöden
* Arbeta med verktyg som GitLab, ArgoCD och Ansible
* Samarbeta med användare kring onboarding, stöd och kontinuerlig förbättring av plattformen
* Samarbeta med säkerhets- och driftorganisationen för att säkerställa krav på tillgänglighet, prestanda och säkerhet
* Arbeta proaktivt med robusthet, observability, säkerhet och incidenthantering


 Vi vill att du
   

  

 Är T-formad med solid grund inom Linux och har vidareutvecklat din kompetens inom någon del av den moderna cloud native-världen. Oavsett om din spets ligger inom Kubernetes, CI/CD tooling, automation, observability eller säkerhet har du en naturlig nyfikenhet och vilja att fortsätta utvecklas.
   

  

* Har erfarenhet av containerteknik och CI/CD tooling i produktionsmiljö, on-prem eller cloud
* Vill ersätta varje manuellt flöde med automation
* Trivs i en dynamisk miljö under uppbyggnad och vill aktivt bidra till arkitektur, teknikval och plattformsutveckling, med ett pragmatiskt förhållningssätt och stark samarbetsförmåga


 Så arbetar vi tillsammans
   

  

 Hos Bankgirot arbetar man gärna tillsammans på kontoret – det stärker samarbete, lärande och den gemensamma kulturen. Här finns goda möjligheter att utvecklas i yrkesrollen och ta nästa steg över tid. Du erbjudes också förmåner som gör skillnad i vardagen, som eget gym, generöst friskvårdsbidrag, cykelförmån samt trygga pensions- och försäkringslösningar.
   

  

 Säkerhetsprövning
   

  

 För rollen genomförs säkerhetsprövning innan anställning i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) – en naturlig del av ansvaret att värna tryggheten i Sveriges betalsystem.
   

  

 Övrig information
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning baserad i Liljeholmen i Stockholm. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Du behöver ha goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.
   

  

 Intresserad?
   

  

 I denna rekrytering samarbetar Bankgirot med Nexer Recruit.
   

  

 Har du frågor eller funderingar? Kontakta gärna rekryteringskonsult Johanna Värmfors: johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com eller +46 730 821 230
   

  

 alternativt Jenny Nilsson: jenny.nilsson@nexergroup.com eller +46 (0)70 301 82 79.
   

  

 Läs om fler lediga tjänster från Bankgirot här.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

 Om Bankgirot
   

  

 Sedan starten 1959 har Bankgirot stått för den tekniska strukturen som binder samman Sveriges banker i det nationella betalsystemet. Företagets historia präglas av innovation, engagemang och stolthet över sitt samhällsviktiga uppdrag. Genom expertkunskap och en stark kultur arbetar man varje dag för att säkerställa att varje transaktion sker sömlöst och effektivt.

title: VP of technology - High growth scale up- Stockholm
description:
**🚀 VP Technology / Principal / Staff engineer - High Growth scale-up - Stockholm 🚀** 




  





 The title can be interchangeable, but what is a given is that this role is the opportunity to be at the tip-of-the spear within one of Stockholm's most exciting and high-impact startups right now!
 



  





 This role is for someone who wants to be at the forefront of technical discovery, AI application, solving complex, unexplored problems, exploring and spearheading new product & engineering initiatives which translate into real-world commercial impact!
 



  





 You won’t be joining to own a particular engineering team or simply deliver against an existing roadmap. You’ll operate across the organisation, working closely with the CTO, head of product, business leadership and an exceptional product-minded engineering org, to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions and figure out what should be built next!
 



  





**What Makes This Role Different ✅** 




  




* A newly created, foundational position with significant freedom to shape the role and having a transformative impact on a company already leading the pack in its field
* Operating across the organisation rather than within a single engineering team
* Close partnership with senior technology and product leadership
* Exposure to complex technical, product and commercial challenges
* Significant autonomy to explore, experiment and influence direction
* The opportunity to work on problems where there is no obvious playbook
* A position at the intersection of technology, product, AI and business strategy



  





**Your Mission ✅** 




  





 Your role will be to find and solve the problems that sit beyond the boundaries of individual teams.
 



 You’ll have the agency to:
 



  




* Explore complex business and technical challenges
* Identify opportunities where technology can create meaningful new value
* Lead early-stage discovery, experimentation and validation
* Turn promising ideas into prototypes, products or new capabilities
* Challenge existing thinking and introduce new approaches
* Influence technical and product strategy
* Connect engineering capability with wider business opportunities
* Help identify potential new products, markets and revenue streams



  





 The emphasis is on discovery and problem solving rather than execution against a predefined backlog.
 



  





**AI & Emerging Technology ✅** 




  





 AI will be an important part of the role and our strategy going forward, but this is not simply an AI engineering position. You’ll be expected to understand where AI and emerging technologies can genuinely change how the organisation operates, what it builds and how it creates value.
 



  





**This could include: ✅** 




  




* Identifying unconventional opportunities for AI across the business
* Exploring emerging technologies and their practical applications
* Rapidly prototyping new concepts
* Evaluating whether an idea has genuine customer or commercial potential
* Taking successful experiments through to production
* Helping shape the broader technology and AI strategy
* Focusing on measurable outcomes rather than experimentation for its own sake



  





**How You'll Work✅** 



* You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy and work horizontally across engineering, product and business functions.



  




* You should be comfortable moving between high-level business problems and deep technical detail, and knowing when to stay strategic versus when to get hands-on.



  




* You won't be expected to manage a large team. Instead, your impact will come through the problems you solve, the direction you influence and the leverage you create for others.



  





**The Ideal Profile ✅** 




  





 You may currently be a Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, VP of Technology or another senior technical leadership position, a founder trapped within a slow moving enterprise org, or maybe you've been a founding engineer or CTO within a high growth startup!
 



  





**More important than your current title is that you: ✅** 




  




* Have significant experience building software and designing complex systems
* Have operated successfully in high-growth or high-change environments
* Enjoy ambiguity rather than needing a clearly defined scope
* Have experience taking ideas from 0→1
* Combine strong technical depth with product and commercial thinking
* Can understand a business problem before jumping to a technical solution
* Have strong architectural judgement and systems thinking
* Are comfortable influencing without formal authority
* Know when to experiment, when to move quickly and when something needs to be built properly
* Are naturally curious about emerging technology and what it could enable



  





**Technology ✅** 




  





 The existing environment includes:
 


* Node.js / TypeScript
* AWS
* MongoDB
* Cloud-native architecture
* Modern engineering practices and tooling



  





 The technology stack is not restrictive. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new technologies where they make sense for the problem being solved.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like ✅** 




  





 Success won't be measured simply by the number of tickets delivered or systems owned.
 



 It will look more like:
 



  




* Complex problems being turned into clear opportunities
* New ideas moving from discovery → prototype → production
* Technology creating measurable new business or product value
* AI being applied in places where it genuinely changes outcomes
* New product or revenue opportunities being identified and validated
* Senior leadership having a trusted technical partner for difficult, ambiguous problems
* The organisation becoming faster and more capable at exploring what comes next



  





 This is a role for someone who wants to be
 **at the frontier of what the organisation could become** 
 , rather than simply maintaining what already exists. Like we mentioned, high ownership, high agency and autonomy, startup ambiguity with an established engineering team and successful product, with a tonne of room to impact!
 



  





 This is a hybrid role, 3 days/week in Stockholm office generally. Unable to assist in Visa sponsorship or extensions at the moment.
 



  





 Compensated with an attractive salary & compensation offering!

title: Data Engineer - skapa innovativa datalösningar tillsammans med Trygg-Hansa
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla ett växande datateam där affärsförståelse, datamodellering och moderna transformationsverktyg står i centrum? Vi söker Data Engineers som vill omsätta data till skalbara och välstrukturerade dataprodukter som skapar värde för verksamheten. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla lösningar som gör data mer tillgängligt, användbart och relevant för beslutsfattande.
   

  

**Om jobbet | Skapa affärsnära datalösningar från idé till färdig dataprodukt**
 Du blir en del av ett affärsnära datateam som arbetar tillsammans med verksamheten för att utveckla datamodeller, transformationer och dataprodukter som används för analys, rapportering och beslutsstöd. Som en del av ett mindre team får du stort ansvar och möjlighet att påverka både arbetssätt och lösningar.
   

  

 Vi utvecklar affärsspecifika dataprodukter och rapporter för den svenska och skandinaviska marknaden, baserade på en gemensam dataplattform inom koncernen. Teknikstacken är under ständig utveckling, med fokus just nu på Trino, Flink, Kubernetes, SQLMesh, Python, Altair SLC och GitLab m.m. Det viktigaste är dock inte att du kan alla verktygen idag, utan att du är nyfiken och vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss.
   

  

 Du samarbetar med kollegor i Sverige och övriga Skandinavien för att utveckla lösningar som stödjer verksamhetens behov och bidrar till datadrivna beslut.
   

  

**Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter**
* Modellera, utveckla och förvalta dataprodukter i vår centrala dataplattform.
* Förstå och omsätta affärsbehov till datamodeller och transformationslogik.
* Förvalta och vidareutveckla rapporter och datalösningar.
* Säkerställa kvalitet, dokumentation och spårbarhet i våra lösningar.
* Samarbeta med andra datateam i Skandinavien kring gemensamma initiativ.
* Stötta verksamheten i användning av data, verktyg och processer.


 Placering är i Stockholm.
   

  

**Om dig | Teknisk kompetens och vilja att utvecklas**
**Vi Tror Att Du Har**
* Relevant utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet som Data Engineer eller systemutvecklare.
* God förståelse för datamodellering, affärslogik och transformationslager.
* Erfarenhet av data lake- eller data warehouse-miljöer.
* Erfarenhet av att bygga och optimera SQL-frågor för större datamängder.
* God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska.


**Det Är Ett Plus Om Du Har**
* Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen eller annan reglerad verksamhet.
* Kunskap om GitLab, SQLMesh, Databricks och Kafka.
* Erfarenhet av streaminglösningar och realtidsarkitektur.


 Som person trivs du med att samarbeta och är intresserad av att förstå verksamhetens behov för att skapa datalösningar som gör konkret nytta. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar med idéer och är öppen för att lära dig nytt. Vi värdesätter samarbete, initiativförmåga och utvecklingsvilja lika högt som erfarenhet av specifika tekniker och verktyg.
   

  

**Om oss | Vi tar ansvar, visar tillit och skapar utveckling**
 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med stort eget ansvar i en kultur som präglas av självledarskap, tillit och samarbete. Vi tror att olika perspektiv bidrar till bättre lösningar och en starkare arbetsmiljö.
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett företag med ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag där data spelar en allt större roll för att skapa trygghet för våra kunder. Vi erbjuder en inkluderande arbetsplats där du kan utvecklas och växa i din roll.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Europe's public institutions serve hundreds of millions of people, and most lack the AI infrastructure to do it well. Intric is changing that. Our sovereign AI platform is already used by 70+ municipalities, governments, and institutions. We've built a leading position in Sweden and are expanding across Europe.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Be the technical owner within customer engagements, working alongside sales and customer success from pre-sales through go-live
* Build integrations across APIs, authentication systems, data pipelines, and document platforms
* Deploy Intric in on-prem and private cloud environments with strict security requirements
* Debug what no one else can figure out, in environments with limited tooling and high constraints
* Turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions customers rely on daily
* Prioritize ruthlessly across competing demands, from a position of knowledge rather than whoever is loudest
* Feed real-world deployment insights back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap


**Who you are**
 You've shipped things that other people depend on. You've been on-call when they broke. You've dealt with real production risk, real failure, and end-to-end ownership without a safety net. That background is what makes the rest of this possible.
   

  

* You work across the full stack without needing to hand off: frontend, backend, infrastructure, AI layer, GitOps, networking, protocols, raw API work
* You take ownership of customer outcomes, not individual tasks. If the customer isn't reaching their goal, that's your problem to solve.
* You can say no to the wrong thing and yes to the right one, even under pressure from the customer.
* You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical department manager and defend it to their engineers, often in the same meeting
* You're effective in ambiguous, under-documented, high-constraint environments


**Fluent** 
**Swedish and English are both required for this role.**
 Your title might have been Implementation Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or something else entirely. What matters is what you actually did: owning delivery in customer environments, end to end, with real stakes attached.
   

  

**What You'll Gain**
 You'll build a combination that's hard to find elsewhere: production-level AI deployment experience in high-security environments, across multiple industries, with direct ownership of customer outcomes from start to finish.
   

  

* Hands-on experience deploying AI in production-critical, high-security environments
* Exposure to complex enterprise architectures across sectors and countries
* Direct influence on product direction through real deployment feedback


**What this job actually looks like**
**Up to 80% of your work happens in customer environments, alongside their technical teams primarly across Sweden with some cross-Nordics travel as projects require** 
 . You learn their systems, integrate the platform, and own the outcome from the first sales conversation through go-live and beyond.
   

  

 The environment spans Python, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, self-hosted LLMs, and Svelte. You won't use all of it on every project, but you need to move across the stack as the situation demands. You use AI tools well and quickly, but your value is the judgment behind them: knowing what to build, how to prioritize, and when to push back.
   

  

 Your default is finding the path, not describing the obstacle. Sometimes that means telling a customer that what they're asking for is the wrong thing to build. Both are part of the job.
   

  

**Why Intric**
* One of Europe's most trusted AI platforms for regulated organizations
* Funded and growing: you're joining before the scale curve, not after
* High ownership and decision-making authority from day one
* A team that takes quality, security, and long-term trust seriously


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and equity
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension) with fund choice and advisory meetings, plus sjukförsäkring, premiebefrielse, TFA, and TGL
* 25 days paid vacation
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)

title: iOS Senior Engineer
description:
We are looking for an iOS developer with strong Swift and SwiftUI experience to work on KSP, our native Sportsbook library embedded in the Unibet Sports iOS App.
 



  





**What you’ll work on** 



* Build and evolve SwiftUI feature modules across the KSP stack
* Integrate KSP into the Sports host app via shared contracts
* Design and maintain modular SPM APIs, keeping module boundaries clean and public surfaces intentional
* Implement real-time sportsbook experiences: odds/live data flows, navigation, analytics, localization, and media
* Own quality end-to-end: unit tests, SwiftUI view tests, lint/format, CI feedback, and PR hygiene
* Collaborate with product, design, QA, and other platform teams on high-impact sportsbook journeys



  





**Our tech stack (what you’ll use day to day)** 



* Language & platform: Swift 5.10+, SwiftUI, iOS 17+, Xcode
* Architecture: Modular Swift Packages, feature-oriented modules composed through an integration layer
* Dependency injection: Factory (Container-based DI, test/preview-friendly registrations)
* Concurrency & reactivity: Structured concurrency (async/await), preference for modern Observation patterns
* Networking & realtime: REST-style providers plus MQTT/WebSocket for live offering data
* Testing: Swift Testing (preferred for new tests), ViewInspector for SwiftUI
* Tooling & delivery: SwiftLint, SwiftFormat, Git hooks, Jira, GitLab, Jenkins/CI, Fastlane



  





**Ideal profile** 




 Must-have
 


* Solid commercial experience building production iOS apps or libraries in Swift
* Strong SwiftUI skills: composition, navigation, state management, performance-aware UI
* Comfortable with modular Swift Package development and multi-repo / multi-package dependency graphs
* Practical experience with async/await and main-actor boundaries, able to reason about concurrency bugs
* Experience writing unit tests and testing UI behavior (XCTest and/or Swift Testing)
* Ability to work in a large codebase with shared components, strict linting, and CI gates
* Clear communication in English and confidence collaborating across squads



 Nice-to-have
 


* Experience with Factory, Resolver, or similar DI containers
* Exposure to Combine and migration toward Observation / @Observable
* Realtime systems experience (MQTT, WebSockets, push-driven UI)
* Sportsbook, betting, trading, or other high-frequency / odds-driven product experience
* Experience embedding libraries into a host app (SDK-style delivery, integration contracts, versioning)
* Familiarity with analytics/tracking instrumentation, localization pipelines, or media/player SDKs
* Comfort with GitLab, conventional PR reviews, and Jira-linked delivery



  





**What success looks like** 



* You deliver reliable sportsbook features with clean module boundaries and predictable integrations
* You write testable, maintainable Swift that fits existing KSP conventions
* You improve live UX quality under real conditions: odds updates, navigation, betslip flows, and streaming
* You leave the codebase healthier than you found it: better tests, clearer APIs, fewer regressions



  





**Soft skills we value** 



* Product mindset: you care about customer journeys, not only tickets
* Pragmatism: prefer simple solutions, abstract complexity only when needed
* Ownership: you follow work through build, test, review, and production feedback
* Collaboration: you can partner with web / backend sportsbook teams and host-app iOS engineers

title: Senior GRC Engineer
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
   

  

 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will lead the engineering behind our governance, risk and compliance (GRC) systems. You will turn security requirements into production controls, evidence pipelines and tests that show whether those controls operate as designed.
   

  

 The Senior GRC Engineer works across security, software engineering and compliance. On one day you might build a pipeline that collects cloud configuration evidence or write a test that detects a failed control. On another day, you might trace a system change to the policies and requirements it affects.
   

  

 You will work with the security, compliance, and legal teams to define the most pressing problems and deliver production solutions without detailed technical direction. And, more broadly, you will take initiative to close gaps that you identify in the course of your work.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Build production systems that collect, validate and preserve technical control evidence.
* Automate shared security controls when a central implementation is the right solution.
* Write tests that show whether controls operate as designed and continue to work over time.
* Connect requirements, controls, implementations, tests, evidence, policies and procedures.
* Detect missing, stale or incomplete evidence. Route failures to a named owner and keep a traceable record.
* Build workflows that identify drift between approved policies and technical implementations.
* Prepare reproducible evidence packages for the Compliance team.
* Join audits as a technical subject matter expert.
* Answer internal questions for go-to-market teams about our compliance and security posture.
* Help the Compliance and Legal teams assess how new requirements affect our security controls and systems.
* Build, deploy and operate approved GRC automation in our production environment.
* Keep the systems maintainable through version control, tests, monitoring and clear operating documentation.


 What success looks like
   

  

 Within your first few months, the first prioritised evidence pipelines and control tests should operate in production. The systems should show where evidence came from, whether it is current and when collection fails. The Compliance team should be able to reproduce selected for key requirements evidence without repeating the original manual work.
   

  

 Over your first year, the Compliance team should receive complete and traceable technical evidence by the agreed dates. Important evidence and control failures should be visible before an audit. Manual collection and evidence rework should decrease as automation covers more of the highest-priority controls.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

 You are a senior engineer who is comfortable owning a defined problem from design through production. You can work independently, explain your decisions and ask for help when a dependency or company-level decision blocks progress.
   

  

 You can:
   

  

* Build and operate production software, automation or data pipelines.
* Work with application programming interfaces, cloud services and structured data from several systems.
* Translate security or compliance requirements into technical controls and testable conditions.
* Design evidence records with clear provenance, scope, collection time and retention requirements.
* Build monitoring that detects failed collection, stale evidence and control failure.
* Apply software engineering practices to compliance work, including testing, version control and code review.
* Explain technical controls and evidence to engineers, compliance colleagues and auditors.
* Make sound engineering decisions when the implementation path is not prescribed.
* Balance automation with access control, data minimisation and operational safety.


 We care more about demonstrated capability than a particular degree, certification or GRC platform.
   

  

 Bonus points
   

  

* Experience with ISO 27001, C5, SOC 2 and other security or quality management assessments.
* Experience with controls as code, policy as code or continuous control monitoring.
* Experience in healthcare, another regulated environment or a high-growth technology company.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, cloud security, identity systems or continuous integration and delivery pipelines.
* Experience integrating compliance platforms or integrated management systems with technical data sources.
* Experience building evidence systems with access, retention and auditability requirements.
* Experience using AI to support control mapping, evidence review or policy analysis with human approval and traceable outputs.


 Location
   

  

 We work best when we spend time together. You will work primarily from our headquarters in central Stockholm.
   

  

 How to apply
   

  

 We review applications continuously. Please apply with your CV in English.
   

  

 Because Tandem handles sensitive patient data, we conduct a background check before hiring.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and company stock options.
* 30 days of paid holiday each year.
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance, plus 6,000 SEK each year for other health-related initiatives.
* Parental leave top-up for new parents.
* Private medical insurance.
* Mental health support through Mindler.
* Pension programme.
* Regular social and team activities, including off-sites and seasonal events.


*We review our benefits regularly and may change them from time to time.*
**Culture at Tandem**
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
   

  

 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
   

  

 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
   

  

 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
   

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About Meela** 




 At Meela, we’re on a mission to make it easier to find the right mental health support, starting with matching people to the therapist that’s the best fit for them. Since launching, we’ve helped over 100,000 people across Sweden and the UK, and we’re just getting started. We’re backed by leading VCs and were recently named as 26th fastest growing startup in the Nordics by Sifted.
 



  





 Our founder Tiffany was named Female Founder of the Year in 2024. But what we’re most proud of is the feedback we get from users: “I finally found someone who gets me.”
 



  





**About the role** 




 We are looking for a passionate Full Stack Developer to join our team of 5 to help build the next stages of the Meela platform. You'll be working on features that directly affect how users find and connect with their ideal therapist - from onboarding flows to therapist matching logic and ongoing communication tools. Your work will directly shape the user experience for both clients and therapists.
 



  





 This is a hybrid role that is based out of our Stockholm office.
 



  





**What you’ll be doing** 



* Building modern, user-friendly frontend features with TypeScript and Solid.js

title: Senior Backend Developer – ITS Distribution & Investments | SEB, Solna
description:

We are looking to strengthen the team that builds Investment Overview, a backend solution that sits at the center of the customer experience and places high demands on correctness, performance, and resilience.
   

  

 SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. In this role, you will be part of designing and implementing the core data layer - including data sourcing, aggregation, compilation, and the API interfaces - that powers this experience end to end.

 The solution will grow over the coming years, so you will be part of clarifying requirements as well as designing the solutions going forward.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity to make a tangible impact and grow your expertise.
   

  

 To thrive in this role, we believe you have:
   

  

* Extensive experience as a Senior C# developer, and the .NET ecosystem.
* The ability and desire to write clean, testable and maintainable code, using agile methodologies as needed.

* Insights related to providing APIs (REST/GraphQL/gRPC) and asynchronous messaging for event driven architectures.
* Experience developing and deploying with Docker and Kubernetes, preferably on GCP.
* Curiosity towards agentic workflows in various parts of software development.

 What we offer:
   

  

* Agile and modern ways of working
* A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views
* Extensive training and learning opportunities
* Hybrid work model, meaning remote work is possible up to 2 days/week
* Innovative company at the forefront of technology


 Do you want to be part of SEB?
   

  

 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026-09-17. If you have questions about the position, please contact Jonas Lindqvist, jonas.lindqvist@seb.se, note that we will not process applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.
   

  

 SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, which means that this position might be covered by internal redeployment.
   

  

 The employment is covered by collective agreements signed between Finansarbetsgivarna and Akademikerföreningen and between Finansarbetsgivarna and Finansförbundet.

title: Senior Java utvecklare till Knowit Stockholm
description:

 Du har ett lösningsorienterat mindset och bidrar till teamets framgång genom samarbete, nyfikenhet och innovation. Du är lyhörd för behov och förutsättningar och har förmågan att omvandla utmaningar till möjligheter.
