title: Senior GRC Engineer
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
==============================================

  

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.


We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

**About the role**
------------------


You will lead the engineering behind our governance, risk and compliance (GRC) systems. You will turn security requirements into production controls, evidence pipelines and tests that show whether those controls operate as designed.


The Senior GRC Engineer works across security, software engineering and compliance. On one day you might build a pipeline that collects cloud configuration evidence or write a test that detects a failed control. On another day, you might trace a system change to the policies and requirements it affects.


You will work with the security, compliance, and legal teams to define the most pressing problems and deliver production solutions without detailed technical direction. And, more broadly, you will take initiative to close gaps that you identify in the course of your work.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Build production systems that collect, validate and preserve technical control evidence.
* Automate shared security controls when a central implementation is the right solution.
* Write tests that show whether controls operate as designed and continue to work over time.
* Connect requirements, controls, implementations, tests, evidence, policies and procedures.
* Detect missing, stale or incomplete evidence. Route failures to a named owner and keep a traceable record.
* Build workflows that identify drift between approved policies and technical implementations.
* Prepare reproducible evidence packages for the Compliance team.
* Join audits as a technical subject matter expert.
* Answer internal questions for go-to-market teams about our compliance and security posture.
* Help the Compliance and Legal teams assess how new requirements affect our security controls and systems.
* Build, deploy and operate approved GRC automation in our production environment.
* Keep the systems maintainable through version control, tests, monitoring and clear operating documentation.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------


Within your first few months, the first prioritised evidence pipelines and control tests should operate in production. The systems should show where evidence came from, whether it is current and when collection fails. The Compliance team should be able to reproduce selected for key requirements evidence without repeating the original manual work.


Over your first year, the Compliance team should receive complete and traceable technical evidence by the agreed dates. Important evidence and control failures should be visible before an audit. Manual collection and evidence rework should decrease as automation covers more of the highest-priority controls.

**What you bring**
------------------


You are a senior engineer who is comfortable owning a defined problem from design through production. You can work independently, explain your decisions and ask for help when a dependency or company-level decision blocks progress.


You can:

* Build and operate production software, automation or data pipelines.
* Work with application programming interfaces, cloud services and structured data from several systems.
* Translate security or compliance requirements into technical controls and testable conditions.
* Design evidence records with clear provenance, scope, collection time and retention requirements.
* Build monitoring that detects failed collection, stale evidence and control failure.
* Apply software engineering practices to compliance work, including testing, version control and code review.
* Explain technical controls and evidence to engineers, compliance colleagues and auditors.
* Make sound engineering decisions when the implementation path is not prescribed.
* Balance automation with access control, data minimisation and operational safety.


We care more about demonstrated capability than a particular degree, certification or GRC platform.

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Experience with ISO 27001, C5, SOC 2 and other security or quality management assessments.
* Experience with controls as code, policy as code or continuous control monitoring.
* Experience in healthcare, another regulated environment or a high-growth technology company.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, cloud security, identity systems or continuous integration and delivery pipelines.
* Experience integrating compliance platforms or integrated management systems with technical data sources.
* Experience building evidence systems with access, retention and auditability requirements.
* Experience using AI to support control mapping, evidence review or policy analysis with human approval and traceable outputs.

**Location**
------------


We work best when we spend time together. You will work primarily from our headquarters in central Stockholm.

**How to apply**
----------------


We review applications continuously. Please apply with your CV in English.


Because Tandem handles sensitive patient data, we conduct a background check before hiring.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary and company stock options.
* 30 days of paid holiday each year.
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance, plus 6,000 SEK each year for other health-related initiatives.
* Parental leave top-up for new parents.
* Private medical insurance.
* Mental health support through Mindler.
* Pension programme.
* Regular social and team activities, including off-sites and seasonal events.

*We review our benefits regularly and may change them from time to time.*

**Culture at Tandem**
=====================

  

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.


Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.


Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.


We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.  

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
==============================================

  

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.


We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

**About the role**
------------------


You will lead the engineering of our security operations programme in Stockholm. The role is hands-on and spans telemetry, detection engineering, incident response and the way we work with our managed detection and response (MDR) provider.


The work is varied. You might trace an identity alert across cloud logs or guide a containment decision during an incident. On another day, you might test whether an AI-assisted investigation workflow is safe enough to use.


You will have a real say in the tools we choose, the processes we build and the skills we add as the team grows. The decisions you make will shape how Tandem handles security incidents for years to come.


This is a senior individual contributor role today. You do not need to want a management role to grow here. If people management interests you later, we can explore that path as the team grows.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own a risk-prioritised plan for bringing data sources into our security information and event management (SIEM) platform.
* Make telemetry dependable. Build checks that show when important data is missing, delayed or incomplete.
* Develop a repeatable detection lifecycle that covers creation, testing, tuning, ownership and retirement.
* Lead the technical response to security incidents. Establish scope, urgency and likely impact, then guide containment and remediation.
* Make containment decisions with the Head of Security and relevant system owners. Take direct action when an approved playbook and delegated authority allow it.
* Coordinate security incidents from detection to closure. Keep playbooks, decision records, escalation paths and after-action reviews useful and current.
* Run practical security incident training and exercises. Help colleagues understand their roles and respond with confidence under pressure.
* Give our medical device regulation compliance and legal teams the technical evidence they need to assess potential privacy incidents.
* Build an effective operating model with our MDR provider and other security partners. Make ownership and hand-offs clear.
* Measure what matters, including telemetry coverage, detection quality, response time, hand-off quality and completed follow-up actions.
* Find practical uses for AI in security operations. Put clear data boundaries, evaluation, human approval, audit and fallback controls around those workflows.
* Document the systems and decisions you build so future team members can contribute quickly.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------


In your first year, your work will allow us to scale out the clear and repeatable process of resolving security incidents from detection to closure. Important telemetry gaps and detection quality should be visible. MDR hand-offs should be seamless, and after-action reviews should lead to delivered improvements.


You will also lay the groundwork for the next phase of security operations at Tandem. The next phase needs clearer ownership, more internal capability and systems that a growing team can build on.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Coordinate security incidents across technical and non-technical teams.
* Judge when to gather more evidence, when to contain and when to escalate.
* Work with telemetry from identity, endpoint, cloud, network and application systems.
* Build and operate SIEM integrations, detections and telemetry health checks.
* Use code or automation to remove repetitive work and make response more reliable.
* Distinguish expected behavior, control failures and credible malicious activity.
* Write clear playbooks, investigation notes and after-action reviews.
* Explain technical risk to engineers, leaders and colleagues outside security.
* Bring structure to an incomplete process without waiting for perfect conditions.
* Work collaboratively and stay calm when the answer is not yet clear.


We are looking for someone who makes sound decisions with incomplete information and explains their reasoning. You should always improve the system after the immediate problem is over.


We care more about demonstrated capability than a particular degree, certification or toolset.

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Experience working with a co-managed MDR or managed security service provider.
* Detection engineering experience, including validation and tuning.
* Experience with incident command, security exercises or internal training.
* Experience in healthcare, another regulated environment or a high-growth technology company.
* Experience managing detections, automation or integrations as version-controlled code.

---------------

**Join fiskaly! Finance that looks forward, not just backward.**

**The Role**

We are looking for an Account Executive – New Business to build a pipeline and close business in new markets. This is an outbound-first role: you will open doors that are not yet open, through cold calling, email, video, LinkedIn and whatever creative prospecting gets you in front of the right person. You own the opportunity from first touch to signature, and you stay close to your customers after the deal is done.



You will be selling into POS providers, billing and invoicing software vendors, ERP partners and retail technology companies — technical buyers who care about API quality and business buyers who care about staying on the right side of the law. Both conversations are yours.


**️** **What You'll Do**
------------------------


* Generate your own pipeline through consistent, high-quality outbound activity: cold calls, sequenced email, video, LinkedIn and creative prospecting
* Run the full funnel: prospecting, discovery, solution mapping, negotiation, contract signing and post-sale support
* Keep the funnel moving: open new opportunities while advancing the deals already in play, with the discipline to do both every week
* Become genuinely credible on the fiscalization and e-invoicing regulations in your markets, so you can answer legal and basic technical questions without needing to escalate every time
* Translate a technical API product into clear business value for non-technical buyers
* Work with Legal and Solution Engineering on the questions that genuinely need them, and bring the market's objections back into the business
* Keep your pipeline data clean and your forecast honest

**What You Bring**
------------------


* At least 5 years in B2B sales with a strong outbound track record — you have built pipeline from nothing, not just worked inbound leads
* **Full professional English and Portuguese**

* Credible presence: you can hold a room with a CFO, a product lead and a developer in it

* It will really impress us if you already have experience in the VAT world — e-invoicing, fiscal reporting or tax compliance software
* International experience in a European startup or scaleup
* Background in compliance, accounting, billing software, POS or PMS
* Experience selling an API-based or otherwise technical product

**✅** **What We Offer**
-----------------------


* 25 vacation days per year
* Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup
* Budget for personal and professional development
* Hardware of your choice (Windows/Mac)
* A company culture that is open, direct, and pragmatic

**Why fiskaly**
---------------



Joining fiskaly means contributing to a mission-driven company that is redefining how compliance is done in Europe and beyond. Here, you'll grow, innovate, and make a real impact on the finance operations of a scaling SaaS company.

title: Product Manager - Alarms
description:
*Do you want to develop products and services that help protect people, property and critical functions around the clock? As Product Manager for Smart Alarms, you will turn customer needs, market insight and technical possibilities into strong solutions and bring them successfully to market across Europe.*


AddSecure is strengthening its Smart Alarms product team, and we are looking for a **Product Manager** in Stockholm who enjoys combining product development, customer insight and commercial thinking with a hands-on understanding of technology.

**AddSecure** is a leading European provider of secure IoT connectivity and end-to-end solutions. We help customers optimise operations, create business value, and secure vital functions. Our solutions are used in buildings, alarms, transport and logistics, personal safety, elderly care, construction, municipalities, schools, rescue services, power grids, retail and more.


Within our Smart Alarms business, we provide secure solutions for monitored alarm transmission and reliable crisis communication, supporting organisations and emergency teams when it matters most.

###### **About the job**


As Product Manager, you will own and develop a portfolio at the heart of our alarm signaling business, spanning lift alarm services, fire and intrusion alarm services, and new products and services brought to market.


You will be responsible for understanding customer and market needs, shaping the roadmap and working closely with R&D to develop solutions that create clear customer value. You will also play an important role in bringing products successfully to market through positioning, packaging, pricing and go-to-market activities.


This is a hands-on product role. Particularly within lift alarms and integrations with third-party products, you will work closely with the technology, testing and verifying solutions to understand how they perform in practice.


You will report to the Product Director for Smart Alarms and work in an international team of Product Managers, close to Sales, Marketing, R&D, Operations and our country teams.


AddSecure works according to a 3/2 hybrid model. You work from the office a minimum of three days per week and remotely up to two days, with Telefonplan in Stockholm as your base and the option to work from other AddSecure offices. The role involves some travel, mainly to our offices, customers and partners across Europe.

**What you will do**

* Own and develop the roadmap for your portfolio, translating customer needs, market insight and technical opportunities into clear priorities.
* Grow and develop our lift alarm, fire and intrusion alarm offerings and identify opportunities for new products, services and markets.
* Work closely with R&D throughout the product lifecycle, from concept and requirements to testing, launch and continuous improvement.
* Lead the market introduction of new products and services together with Sales, Marketing, Operations and country teams, including positioning, packaging, pricing, sales enablement and launch material.
* Build strong relationships with customers and partners and use their feedback to shape existing and future solutions.
* Set prices within agreed guardrails and support the development and maintenance of price lists across our markets.
* Follow revenue, margin, adoption and other relevant product performance indicators and use the insights to support priorities and business cases.
* Drive digital initiatives related to the portfolio, including customer-facing tools and solutions used to install and commission products.
* Represent AddSecure at relevant trade fairs and industry events and bring market insight back into the product roadmap.

###### **About you**


You are a hands-on Product Manager who enjoys being close to both customers and technology. You are curious about how products work in practice and comfortable moving between technical discussions, customer needs and business priorities.


You can create structure in a complex environment, make decisions based on incomplete information and bring different stakeholders together around clear product priorities. You are also comfortable taking products all the way from idea and development to launch and continuous improvement.

**We believe you have:**

* At least 3 years of experience in product management, product ownership or a similar role within B2B technology.
* Experience working with technically complex products or services, ideally within alarms, security, connected hardware or other safety-critical environments.
* Experience taking hardware, software or connected services from development to market.
* Strong product and commercial judgement, with the ability to balance customer value, technical feasibility and business impact.
* The ability to work effectively across R&D, Sales, Marketing, Operations and international teams.
* Technical fluency to work confidently with connected hardware, software and cloud services, together with a willingness to test and understand products hands-on.
* Experience engaging directly with customers and partners and translating their needs into product priorities and requirements.
* A relevant academic background or equivalent professional experience.
* Fluent English, spoken and written.

**It would be valuable if you also have:**

* Professional Swedish or another Nordic language.
* Familiarity with European alarm standards such as EN 50131, EN 54, EN 81-28 or EN 50136.
* Experience from IoT connectivity, telecom or SaaS.
* Experience working through channel partners such as distributors, wholesalers or installers.
* Experience working across several European markets.

###### **We offer**


Our employees are our greatest asset and for us it is of great importance to build a culture where our employees thrive and want to perform. You will be part of a motivated team in an international company. In addition, we offer:

* Wellness allowance
* Occupational pension
* Enhanced parental pay
* Health checks
* Parking


Start: preferably as soon as possible / according to agreement

###### **We're all change makers!**


If you're looking for an organisation where you can be yourself, have fun at work, and contribute to a safer, smarter, and more sustainable world, AddSecure may be the place for you. Join our growing international team, where every day offers an opportunity to make a real difference.


Would you like to take part in our journey? Please apply by submitting your CV and answering a few short questions. We look forward to receiving your application.


We use a competence-based recruitment process that may include psychometric assessments, interviews, reference checks, and background checks. As part of the process, candidates may complete assessments provided by Alva Labs to support a fair and structured evaluation.  

  

We conduct background checks for all our employees, and you must be eligible to work in Sweden.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**The role**
------------


Help shape the future of our games by turning player behaviour data into decisions that improve player experience and commercial success.


As a Senior Data Scientist, you will help us make sense of our raw game and business data. Together, we want to improve our games and influence business and product decisions by making the most out of our data.
  

  

You will analyze player behavior, design experiments, build predictive models, create visualizations, and work with production data pipelines. Our data platform is built on Google Cloud Platform, and we primarily work with BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Apache Beam, and Python or R.
  

  

For this role, you must understand and communicate key insights and questions clearly to colleagues outside the team. You have professional experience applying data science to real-world products and a background in computer science, physics, mathematics or a similar field.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Help teams make better decisions by translating complex data into actionable insights.
* Plan and lead data science projects from idea to production.
* Design and analyse experiments to evaluate gameplay and business initiatives.
* Build, deploy and maintain machine learning models where appropriate.
* Create dashboards and visualizations that communicate insights clearly.
* Champion data science and evidence-based decision making across the studio.
* Closely collaborate with design & research to drive decisions across the game

**Requirements**
----------------

* min. 5 years of hands-on experience with developing custom data models and algorithms to address business challenges using SQL, Python, or R.
* Experience working with production data pipelines and ETL frameworks and automation (e.g., Airflow, Beam).
* University degree within Data Science or similar field
* Strong analytical skills and a curiosity for understanding complex systems and player behaviour.
* Great communication skills. Ability to clearly formulate and articulate the problem at hand in a simple, actionable way (especially to colleagues without a data science background).
* Self-motivated and proactive with critical thinking and the resourcefulness to drive projects to success.
* The ability to work independently as well as in a collaborative environment.

**Extra points**
----------------


Previous experience in games industry.

**Who we are**
--------------


Sharkmob is a Swedish game developer founded in 2017. We create AAA-quality games for PC and console, using the Unreal Engine to power our ambitions of taking multiplayer games to new heights.  

We are currently developing ***Exoborne***, our first original IP. In 2022, we released *Bloodhunt,* a battle royale set in the *Vampire: The Masquerade* universe.
  

  

At Sharkmob, we believe great games are created by diverse teams with different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We are committed to building an inclusive and collaborative workplace where creativity can thrive. Our culture is built around shared ownership, a passion for creating great games, and, just as importantly, having fun along the way.  

  

We’d love for you to join us on our journey and become part of our crew. To learn more about Sharkmob, our projects, and the perks of being a crew member, visit our **homepage**.
company_description: Sharkmob is a game development studio on an epic journey, and we want you to join us! Come explore new territory in the realm of AAA online gaming.

title: Regeringskansliet söker en grafisk formgivare (kort vikariat)
description:
**RK Kommunikation, Förvaltningsavdelningen**  

Är du en serviceinriktad formgivare? Har du erfarenhet av att arbeta utifrån samt förvalta och utveckla en grafisk profil i en större organisation? Vi söker en formgivare för ett kortare vikariat och erbjuder ett omväxlande och kreativt arbete mitt i händelsernas centrum.


**Din arbetsdag. Sveriges morgondag.**  

RK Kommunikation är Regeringskansliets kommunikationsfunktion som ansvarar för att ge kommunikativt stöd till Statsrådsberedningen, departementen och Förvaltningsavdelningen. Avdelningen samordnar och förmedlar extern och intern kommunikation om regeringens arbete och Regeringskansliets verksamhet, samt utvecklar och förvaltar Regeringskansliets gemensamma kommunikationskanaler och Regeringskansliets grafiska profil.


Tjänsten tillhör sektionen Medieproduktion med 12 medarbetare. Tillsammans med övriga formgivare i sektionen producerar du material för myndighetens olika kanaler, både i tryckt och digital form. Du stöttar och ger råd till kollegor i formgivningsfrågor.


Du arbetar framför allt operativt med att visualisera regeringens politik men en viktig del av rollen är också den löpande förvaltningen och utvecklingen av Regeringskansliets grafiska profil.


Läs mer om vår verksamhet på www.regeringen.se .


**Din bakgrund**  

Du har eftergymnasial utbildning i design, grafisk form eller motsvarande. Du har några års erfarenhet av att arbeta med grafisk form samt erfarenhet av designarbete utifrån en grafisk profil inom en större organisation. Det är meriterande om du har aktuell erfarenhet av den typen av arbete på Regeringskansliet. Det är också meriterande om du är van vid filmredigering. Som formgivare på Regeringskansliet arbetar du i både Mac- och PC-miljö.


Du har goda kunskaper i grafisk form för digitala kanaler likväl som tryckt material, typografi, rörlig design och bildspråk. Du är en van användare av programmen inom Adobe Creative Cloud suite. Särskilt InDesign, Illustrator och Photoshop. Rollen kräver även att du har goda kunskaper i Officepaketet och goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.


**Dina egenskaper**  

Regeringskansliets medarbetarkriterier är helhet, utveckling och resultat. Alla som arbetar i Regeringskansliet behöver ha helhetssyn och samarbeta för verksamhetens bästa. Du förväntas bidra med ditt perspektiv och din kompetens samt vara öppen för andras. Du kommer med idéer och nya angreppssätt för att förbättra och utveckla verksamheten och din egen kompetens. Du är inriktad på resultat i ditt agerande och anpassar dig när behov och inriktning ändras.


För att lyckas i rollen behöver du dessutom vara självgående och ha ett serviceinriktat förhållningssätt. Du är strukturerad, planerar och prioriterar ditt arbete effektivt och håller givna tidsramar. Eftersom arbetet präglas av många kontaktytor är det viktigt att du har en mycket god samarbetsförmåga. Du har också gott omdöme och gör korrekta avvägningar vid beslut och prioriteringar. Vi lägger stor viktig vid dina personliga egenskaper.


Läs mer på Medarbetarskap och ledarskap i Regeringskansliet - Regeringen.se


**Övrigt**  

Visstidsanställning under tre månader med tillträde i början av oktober, eller enligt överenskommelse. Det kan finnas möjlighet till förlängning.
  

  

Vänligen bifoga arbetsprover i din ansökan.
  

  

En säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas.


**Är du intresserad?**  

Vill du veta mer om jobbet och vad vi erbjuder, kontakta Linn Duvhammar, sektionschef. Du kan även kontakta Carl Garellick, rekryteringsspecialist. Fackliga kontaktpersoner är Johan Strokirk för Saco och Jan Wahlström för ST. Du når samtliga via Regeringskansliets växel, 08-405 10 00.


Vi tar gärna emot samtal från dig som är intresserad av jobbet men vi tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.


Välkommen att registrera din ansökan i vårt rekryteringsverktyg **senast den 23 september.**

Regeringskansliets uppdrag är att stödja regeringen i dess arbete med att styra Sverige och förverkliga sin politik. Här arbetar 4 800 personer, varav 600 utomlands. Regeringskansliet välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Vi ser jämställdhet och mångfald som en styrka och tillgång och vi arbetar aktivt för att vara en arbetsplats fri från diskriminering. Förvaltningsavdelningen ansvarar för myndighetsövergripande frågor som förändrings- och förnyelsearbete, ekonomi, arbetsgivarfrågor, kompetensförsörjning, kommunikation, säkerhet, it, bibliotek, arkiv och registratur samt för den gemensamma servicen i Regeringskansliet.
company_description: I Regeringskansliet jobbar vi med sakfrågor som spänner över många samhällsområden. Vårt uppdrag är att stödja regeringen i arbetet att styra landet och förverkliga sin politik.

title: Technical Success Manager- Nordics
description:
Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day.


Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead.


At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves.


We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them.


Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast

  

**Job Description:**

The Technical Success Manager (TSM) is a high-impact customer-facing role for someone who enjoys combining technical depth, customer advocacy, and commercial awareness to help customers get lasting value from cybersecurity technology.


In this role, you will partner with security, IT, and technical stakeholders to turn deployment into meaningful adoption, helping customers embed the platform into daily security operations, reduce risk, and achieve measurable outcomes.


You will work closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, and Renewals , bringing a clear technical view of customer health, adoption progress, risks, and renewal readiness .


This is remote position from Copenhagen or Stockholm.


**What will I be doing:**

* Build trusted relationships with customer security and IT teams, understanding their priorities, workflows, and success outcomes.
* Create practical technical success plans that help customers adopt the platform, reduce risk, and realise measurable value.
* Identify high-value use cases that make the platform part of everyday security operations.
* Use product usage, engagement, and health indicators to spot adoption gaps, underutilisation, and retention risks early.
* Guide customers through the transition from deployment to active use, accelerating Time-to-Value and reducing handover friction.
* Lead mitigation planning for technical blockers, integration challenges, operational gaps, and customer health risks.
* Bring clear technical health insights into renewal readiness, QBRs, growth discussions, and account strategy.
* Surface technical opportunities that support expansion, upsell, and cross-sell activity in partnership with the Account Executive.
* Champion the voice of technical users by ensuring product feedback, risks, and success requirements are visible internally.
What Success Looks Like


* Customers are healthier, more engaged, and prepared for renewal and expansion .
* Technical risks are identified early and managed before they affect confidence or outcomes.
* Customers reach value faster after deployment or major use case activation.
* You are recognised by customers and account teams as a trusted, practical technical advisor.
**What experience do I need:**

* Fluency in Swedish or Danish and English is essential.
* You have 3+ years' experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as Customer Success Manager, Technical Success Manager, Technical Account Manager, Technical Consultant, Product Specialist, or similar.
* You understand enterprise cybersecurity, networking, cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments.
* You know how to drive adoption, retention, technical value realisation, and customer health improvement.
* You can translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for customers and internal teams.
* You are confident engaging with security engineers, SOC analysts, system administrators, technical leaders, and executives.
* You bring strong communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience with security operations, SOC workflows, threat detection, or incident response use cases is desirable.
* Familiarity with customer success platforms, health scoring, adoption analytics, and renewal governance is advantageous.
This is an opportunity to sit at the centre of customer value, technical strategy, and retention, helping customers turn powerful cybersecurity technology into sustained operational impact.

  

As a growing business strengthening its governance and controls, this role plays a part in supporting high standards of integrity and accountability.

  

*Darktrace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

*Darktrace is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact your Talent Partner.*

title: Digital Product Manager - CRM
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. The choices we make today define the world we will live in tomorrow. Climate change, population growth and increasing urbanization are shifting expectations on transport and infrastructure, making sustainable transportation increasingly important.

 **Shape the Future of Customer Engagement at Volvo Trucks**

  

Location: Gothenburg, Sweden

  

At Volvo Trucks, we're driving the transformation of the transport industry. As digitalization, connectivity, and customer expectations reshape the market, we are building the digital capabilities that will define the future of customer relationships and commercial success.

  

We are now looking for a Digital Product Manager CRM who wants to play a key role in this journey.  

If you are passionate about combining business strategy, customer experience, and digital innovation while leading CRM digital products that create measurable value on a global scale, this could be the opportunity for you.

 **About the Team**  

You will join Volvo Trucks Digital Management, the organization responsible for end-to-end digital product management, architecture, and digital investments that accelerate business value creation across Volvo Trucks.

  

Our mission is clear: to enable Volvo Trucks to achieve its ambitious targets through world-class digital capabilities. We work at the intersection of business, technology, data, and customer experience, creating digital products that deliver tangible value for our customers, dealers, markets, and internal stakeholders.  

Within the organization, you will be part of the Digital Products Marketing, CRM & Truck Sales digital product team and report to the Director of the function.

 **About the Role**  

As Digital Product Manager CRM, you will own the digital product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Volvo Trucks' CRM capabilities.  

Working closely with business leaders, users, architects, and development teams, you will identify opportunities, prioritize investments, and ensure our CRM products create value for customers, sales organizations, and the business.  

You will be a key driver of digital transformation, helping Volvo Trucks strengthen customer relationships and improve commercial performance through modern CRM capabilities.

 **What You'll Do**  

Set the Direction

* Define and drive the CRM digital products vision, strategy, and roadmap.
* Identify opportunities that improve customer engagement, sales effectiveness, and business performance.
* Drive product prioritization based on business value, customer needs, data and measurable outcomes.

  

Deliver Measurable Business Value

* Measure and realize product value through outcomes and OKRs.
* Use customer insights, analytics, and feedback to guide product decisions.
* Ensure digital products deliver exceptional user experiences and tangible business benefits.

  

Lead Through Collaboration

* Partner with Marketing, Sales, CRM specialists, Digital teams and external partners.
* Build strong relationships, create engagement and foster a collaborative and inclusive culture across business and technology stakeholders.

  

Drive Continous Improvement

* Explore new opportunities through data, innovation, and emerging technologies.
* Leverage Salesforce capabilities, data, and emerging technologies to create value.
* Support successful releases, adoption, and continuous improvement.

 **What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**


* A clear CRM digital product strategy and roadmap is established and aligned with business priorities.
* Stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, and Digital teams are engaged and working toward shared goals.
* Key CRM initiatives are successfully delivered with measurable business impact.
* Product decisions are driven by customer insights, data, and outcome metrics.
* CRM adoption and business confidence in the product continue to grow.
* Salesforce capabilities are leveraged more effectively to support customer engagement and commercial excellence.

 **Who You Are**  

You are a strategic thinker with a strong customer mindset and a passion for turning business ambitions into digital solutions.  

You thrive in environments where you can influence, collaborate, and lead transformation. You are equally comfortable discussing customer experience strategies with business leaders as you are working closely with development teams to define priorities and outcomes.

 **We Believe You Bring**

* Proven experience in Digital Product Management, Product Ownership, or a similar leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of agile product development and modern product management practices.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and stakeholders at different levels.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience using data to support decision-making.
* Experience working with OKRs and value-based product management
* Experience within CRM, Marketing, Sales, or Customer Experience.
* Knowledge of commercial processes and customer lifecycle management.
* Experience working with digital platforms, such as Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud and Experience Cloud) and Medallia.

 **Why Volvo Trucks?**  

At Volvo Trucks, you will have the opportunity to influence digital products used across a global organization and help shape the future of customer engagement.  

You'll work with talented colleagues across business and technology, contribute to meaningful transformation, and play an important role in driving the future of sustainable transport solutions.  

Most importantly, you'll have the chance to make a real impact by creating digital capabilities that strengthen customer relationships and support business growth around the world.

 **Ready to Make an Impact?**  

Join Volvo Trucks and help build the next generation of CRM capabilities that drive customer success and business growth worldwide.

  

Last application date:September 17, 2026.

  

As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.

  

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

 **Who we are and what we believe in**  

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

  

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

  

At **Volvo Trucks** you will be part of leading the way towards a sustainable transport industry. For nearly a century we have been innovating for people – to make life easier, better and safer. Driving progress is our promise to customers, to the industry and to society. At Volvo Trucks we share a curiosity to learn, we work with passion and we embrace change to stay ahead. Join us, together we move the world we want to live in.
company_description: Every day, we work with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to leave our society in better shape for the next generation.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:

title: Azure Cloud Engineer
description:
Vill du ta din expertis inom Azure till nästa nivå? Vi söker en person med erfarenhet inom Microsoft Cloud som vill vara med och designa, bygga och optimera framtidens molnlösningar tillsammans med oss på Accelerate. Hos oss får du inte bara arbeta med moderna tekniker och spännande uppdrag, du blir en del av ett värderingsdrivet och passionerat team där du får goda möjligheter till personlig utveckling.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Som Azure Cloud Engineer hos oss är du en nyckelspelare i att skapa stabila, säkra och moderna molnplattformar åt våra kunder. Du blir motorn bakom en friktionsfri resa från kod till produktion genom att automatisera, effektivisera och optimera kundernas Azure-miljöer. Vi ser dig som den som frigör kraften i molnet, så att utvecklingsteamen kan fokusera på innovation.
 



  





**Exempel på vad du kommer att göra:** 



* Bygga och underhålla en modern, säker och skalbar infrastruktur i Azure med Infrastructure as Code.
* Hantera lösningar inom PaaS (Platform as a Service) och IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), inklusive Azure VM, Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps m.m.
* Säkerställa governance och compliance genom att implementera och hantera Azure Policy, RBAC och Workload Identity Federation.
* Optimera och implementera effektiva lösningar för monitorering och loggning med hjälp av Azure Monitor, Log Analytics och Application Insights.
* Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet och lösa komplexa utmaningar inom nätverk och säkerhet i Azure.



  





**Vem är du?** 




 Vi söker dig som är har gedigen erfarenhet som Cloud Engineer och som brinner för Cloud lösningar såsom Azure, automation och säkerhet. Du har ett lösningsfokuserat mindset och vill hjälpa våra kunder att bygga hållbara och effektiva molnlösningar.
 



  





 Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift. För denna position krävs svenskt medborgarskap, vi utför även bakgrundskontroll av slutkandidat.
 



  





**Vi tror att du gillar att jobba med** 



* Cloud Infrastruktur: Azure VM, Azure Network, Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure Kubernetes Services
* Azure-tjänster som Function Apps, App Services, Key Vault och Storage Accounts
* Säkerhet och compliance: Entra ID, Managed Identities, RBAC, Azure Policy, Microsoft Security
* Monitorering och loggning: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights
* Infrastructure as Code: som t ex Bicep
* Erfarenhet av att bygga cloudmiljöer enligt CAF (Cloud Adotions Framework) eller liknande.



  





**Plus Om Du Har** 



* Certifieringar som AZ-104 och/eller AZ-204
* Erfarenhet av: Azure Landing Zones
* AZ-400, AZ-305 eller motsvarande



  





**Varför Accelerate?** 




 Vi erbjuder dig mer än ett uppdrag – vi erbjuder en plattform för att växa som expert inom Microsoft Cloud så som Azure Infrastruktur, Azure DevOps och andra Microsoft Cloud lösningar! Hos oss får du chansen att arbeta i en modern och framtidsinriktad molnmiljö tillsammans med erfarna kollegor som är Microsoft MVP och Microsoft Certified Trainer inom Azure. Här blir du en del av en kultur där vi lär av varandra och bygger lösningar som verkligen gör skillnad hos våra kunder.
 



  





**Som konsult hos oss får du** 



* En skräddarsydd utvecklings- och certifieringsplan
* Utmanande och varierande uppdrag med de senaste teknikerna
* Flexibilitet, frihet och balans mellan jobb och fritid
* Kollektivavtal, friskvårdsbidrag och sjuk- och hälsoförsäkring
* Ett sammansvetsat team av vassa specialister som lyfter varandra
* En trygg och säker anställning med bra förmåner



  





 Vi tror på gemenskap och kompetensutbyte – här utvecklas vi tillsammans och stöttar varandra för att alltid ligga i framkant.
 



  





**Placeringsort** 




 Accelerate finns på flertal orter i Sverige och Norge. För denna tjänst utgår du från vårt kontor i Stockholm, med möjlighet till hybridarbete.
 



  





 Önskad start är snarast eller enligt överenskommelse. Har du frågor? Kontakta Jesper Carlsson på jesper.carlsson@iver.se
 



**Vi ser fram emot att träffa dig! Välkommen till Accelerate**

title: Solutions Engineer
description:

 Sales Engineering

 Mid-Senior level
   

  

**Job Description:**
 At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

We are responsible for securing the technical win in each sales opportunity and for building an ongoing relationship with our customers to ensure their business success with Cloudera technologies.
   

  

****As a Solutions Engineer you will:****
* Own the technical sales process from introductory meetings (net new sales) through post-sales (customer satisfaction, upselling, and subscription renewals)

 Achievements are aligned to a team goal with annual sales targets, as well as to your participation in knowledge exchange with peers and the wider community.

* Generous PTO Policy

 Du blir en av tre specialister inom Azure Managed HSM och Key Vault och en del av ett team som ansvarar för tjänster inom nyckelhantering, secrets och närliggande infrastruktur. Teamet arbetar agilt med stöd av teamcoach och infrastrukturarkitekt i en miljö som präglas av samarbete, kunskapsdelning och hög teknisk kompetens.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Som Azure Infrastructure Engineer ansvarar du för drift, förvaltning och vidareutveckling av några av bankens mest säkerhetskritiska Azure-tjänster. Rollen kombinerar operativt arbete, teknisk problemlösning och kontinuerliga förbättringar i en miljö med höga krav på tillgänglighet, säkerhet och stabilitet.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:
   

  

* Infrastrukturen för Azure Managed HSM och Key Vault.

 Rollen inkluderar beredskap.

 Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och trivs i komplexa tekniska miljöer. Du arbetar strukturerat, tar ansvar för det du levererar och gillar att lösa problem tillsammans med andra.

description:

 As a Consulting Manager, you are responsible for market awareness within Hybrid and Sovereign Cloud, networking, sales, and driving our business forward while creating value for your area and your consultants. You support and drive sales dialogues, upcoming tenders, and business discussions, and collaborate both regionally and nationally on various key initiatives.

 Your development matters to us. We encourage continuous learning and make sure that you and your interests are in focus. We know that people are the heart of our company, which is why we value joy, creativity, and different perspectives in everything we do.

title: Lakebase Sales Specialist
description:
SLSQ327R347
   

  

 Databricks is seeking a
 **Lakebase Sales Specialist** 
 to help customers modernise their operational data foundation with
 **Databricks Lakebase** 
 , our
 **fully-managed Postgres** 
 offering for
 **intelligent applications** 
 . This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.
   

  

 Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for
 **operational workloads** 
 and
 **AI-native applications** 
 , helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Have**
* Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team
* Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas, including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT, articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency
* Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences
* Run complex sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders
* Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists
* Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references
* Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape
* Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs
* Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organisation


**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
 This role requires the ability to operate across
 **two key motions** 
 simultaneously:
   

  

* Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase
* Drive longer-term Postgres standardisation and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts


**Success In This Role Requires Strength In Four Areas**
* Business ownership: Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.
* Strategic account engagement: Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.
* Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention.
* Market voice and thought leadership: Develop an internal and external presence, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.


 The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.
   

  

**What We Look For**
* Relevant enterprise sales experience, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals
* Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders
* Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies
* Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners)
* Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities
* Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers
* Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes
* Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences
* Bachelor’s degree


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services, ideally within large or strategic accounts
* Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies
* Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications
* Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services
* Prior experience in a high-growth, category-creating environment, helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives
* Experience collaborating with partners and ISVs to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions


*This description is intended to outline the core responsibilities and qualifications for the Lakebase Sales Specialist role. Actual responsibilities may evolve as the Lakebase product and go-to-market motions continue to grow and mature.*

 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents.  At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Staff Core Data
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

 We are hiring a Staff Core Data Engineer to set the direction for how Mentimeter's products define, emit, and evolve data. This is a senior, hands-on systems role focused on product data semantics, canonical events, and architectural intent. Like every Staff role at Mentimeter, the leverage comes through teams: you define the patterns, guardrails, and decision frameworks, and work hands-on with the teams that carry them into production. The role is cross-cutting by design. While reporting into Engineering, the mandate spans Product, Data Platform, Analytics, AI, and GTM.
   

  

 This role exists to turn Mentimeter's product activity into a strategic asset by establishing Core Data as the connective tissue between products, insights, and decisions. This role does not run analytics or platforms. It defines meaning, standards, and direction.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Establish and evolve Core Data as a first class domain at Mentimeter, defining how product signals are captured, trusted, and turned into insights and decisions across the company
* Act as the founder and steward of Canonical Domain Events, ensuring they become the shared language between products, analytics, and decision making
* Define data contracts at emission, ensuring signals are consistent, trustworthy, and reusable
* Shape architecture intent for how product signals flow into analytics, AI, recommendations, and GTM systems further downstream
* Work closely with product and engineering teams to ensure features are designed with learning and signal quality in mind
* Enable governance through design. Clear models, strong defaults, guardrails, and explicit tradeoffs rather than process or policing
* Act as the Staff-level reference point for Core Data design across the company, bringing your craft into the teams doing the work rather than building beside them


**Where we are today**
* In-product events already stream through Redpanda into ClickHouse, giving us interaction-level product signals in near real time
* Event schemas are versioned from the start. You will be a part of how they evolve: compatibility, deprecation, and contracts downstream consumers can trust
* Redpanda and ClickHouse are the substrate, not the job. The platform is in place so you can help work on semantics, standards, and direction


**Success criteria**
* Mentimeter shifts away from treating a single database as truth, instead grounding decisions in shared, trusted signals expressed through Canonical Domain Events
* New products and features natively emit Canonical Domain Events as part of normal development
* Core Data shortens the loop between product behavior and product decisions
* Teams design, emit, and evolve events autonomously within shared guardrails. Core Data creates leverage, not dependency on one person


**We believe you have**
* 8+ years of experience designing and owning data-heavy systems in product-led companies
* You work in learning loops: clarify outcome, ship, observe, learn. Impact and insight over output
* Strong systems thinking and comfort reasoning about boundaries, contracts, and long-term evolution
* Hands-on technical credibility. You can read, write, and reason about production code and data models
* Experience working close to product teams, shaping instrumentation and learning loops at the source
* Ability to translate complex systems into clear models others can follow
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and driving clarity through action


**What This Role Is Not**
* Not a reporting or analytics role
* Not a data platform operations role
* Not a Martech or GTM tooling role
* Not a people-management-first role


**Not Required**
 Swedish is not required (as daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts 50+ different nationalities)
   

  

**What Mentimeter Can Offer**
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Vi på Iteam tror att stora organisationer förtjänar samma handlingskraft som de bästa startups: förmågan att fatta egna beslut, anpassa sig snabbt och äga sin egen digitala framtid. Vi kallar det resiliens och rådighet, och det är dit vi tar våra kunder.
 



  





 Det gör vi genom att bygga öppna, sammankopplade system där användaren alltid är utgångspunkten och kunden alltid äger de viktiga besluten. Flera av våra uppdrag är öppen källkod, som Klimatkollen, bostadsbolaget Mimer och Centrum för Näringslivshistorias Digitala Läsesal, för att det är det ärligaste sättet att bygga något som verkligen tillhör kunden.
 



  





**Din roll** 




 Det här är en roll för dig som är en stark systemutvecklare och brinner för att bygga med AI. Hos oss innebär det att bygga lösningar som faktiskt gör skillnad för kundens affär, inte proof of concepts som samlar damm, utan system som användarna förlitar sig på. Vi jobbar i tvärfunktionella team där vi är ödmjuka, lite lagom tokiga och törstar efter att lära nytt och göra saker på ett bättre sätt. Du trivs med att omväxlande arbeta explorativt med att hitta lösningar och använda ditt sinne för detaljer och din envishet för att utveckla och slutföra tjänster och system.
 



  





 Du bidrar till att våra kunder lyckas genom att
 


* Skriva kod och tester som kan vidareutvecklas av andra
* Konkretisera abstrakta problem och hitta lösningar tillsammans med våra kunder
* Delta i code reviews och parprogrammering
* Förutse utmaningar gällande ex skalbarhet, säkerhet, drift, underhåll
* Samarbeta, lära ut och lära av resten av teamet
* Använda AI-verktyg som en naturlig del av ditt arbetsflöde: till kodgenerering, felsökning och att hitta lösningar snabbare.
* Hålla dig uppdaterad inom AI-utvecklingen och omsätta ny kunskap i praktiken.



  





**Krav** 



* God förmåga att leda sig själv
* God samarbetsförmåga
* God erfarenhet av Typescript och Node.js
* Erfarenhet av att designa och implementera LLM-baserade flöden: promptteknik, kedjade anrop, hantering av kontextfönster och utvärdering av modellsvar
* Erfarenhet av RAG och vektordatabaser
* Erfarenhet som konsult
* Svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet inom systemutveckling



  





**Meriterande** 



* Erfarenhet av agentbaserade arkitekturer
* Erfarenhet av AI-orkestreringsverktyg som n8n, LangChain, CrewAI eller liknande
* Erfarenhet av att bygga och felsöka autonoma agenter eller multi-agent-system
* Erfarenhet av fler backendtekniker än de som är krav - t ex .NET, Python, Java, Elixir, Go, Rust
* Erfarenhet av någon form av frontendutveckling i t ex React.js, Vue, React Native
* Erfarenhet av databaser som MongoDB, SQL Server, Postgres, MariaDB, Redis
* Erfarenhet av Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (ex Flux CD)
* Erfarenhet av asynkrona mönster och köhantering (t ex BullMQ, RabbitMQ eller Kafka)
* Leda team och grundläggande teamdynamik
* Någon annan imponerande förmåga vi inte visste att vi behövde ;-)



  





**Om Iteam** 




 Iteam har funnits sedan 1995 och är runt 20 utvecklare, UX designers, strateger och projektledare utspridda i Sverige och med kontor på Götgatan i Stockholm. Vi är en flexibel arbetsplats med stor möjlighet till att arbeta hemifrån.
 



  





**Ansökan** 




 Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning. 6 månaders provanställning, sedan fast anställning
 



 Omfattning: Heltid
 



 Plats: Stockholm
 



 Start: September-Oktober
 



 Sista ansökningsdatum: Vi intervjuar löpande!

title: Technology Administrator
description:
As Technology Administrator for the Permian and Highvern group based in the Swedish office, you will be responsible for carrying out group-wide user account administration, resolving helpdesk tickets, maintaining asset registers, and providing local desktop support. This is a hands-on operational role focused on delivering timely, practical support to users, completing agreed technology processes accurately, and escalating more complex issues where required. You’ll work closely with global colleagues while taking day-to-day ownership of local support and assigned group-wide administration tasks. In this role you
 **r** 
 eport to the Business Systems Manager (Jersey)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**User Account Administration**
* Carry out joiner, mover, and leaver processes across all systems in line with agreed policy and process frameworks.
* Maintain and audit user access rights, ensuring compliance with security policies including ISAE3402 controls.
* Follow agreed identity and access management practices consistently.
* Update user administration records and complete process changes as instructed.


**Helpdesk & Application Support**
* Log, triage, and resolve group-wide helpdesk tickets, escalating where appropriate.
* Provide 1st/2nd line support for business applications (e.g., NavOne, Diligent, Xodosign, iManage, Microsoft Office).
* Record recurring issues clearly and support agreed fixes or workarounds.


**Local Desktop & Infrastructure Support**
* Install, configure, and maintain desktop, laptop, and meeting room equipment.
* Ensure timely patching, updates, and resolution of technical or security issues.
* Deliver proactive support and training to local users.
* Technology Asset Management
* Maintain accurate records of global IT assets including hardware and software.
* Manage asset lifecycle from procurement to retirement.
* Support audits and ensure compliance with asset management policies.


**Scope**
* Service delivery responsibilities span all Highvern and Permian jurisdictions.
* Operational duties relate specifically to the Technology Team, with a focus on completing assigned support and administration tasks accurately and on time.


**Skills, Knowledge & Experience**
* Experience working within an internal IT department and providing 1st line support to internal users, preferably within a financial services environment.
* Strong experience in user account administration and access control.
* Proven ability to resolve helpdesk tickets and technical issues directly, escalating more complex matters when required.
* Hands-on experience with desktop hardware, software, and infrastructure support.
* Experience in technology asset management and operational processes.
* ITIL Foundation certification (preferred).
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.
* Self-starter with the ability to work independently and take initiative.


**Recruitment process**
 Applications will be reviewed, and interviews conducted, on a rolling basis, so early application is encouraged. As part of our recruitment process, the successful candidate will be required to complete a pre-employment background check. We look forward to welcoming your application

title: Lösningsarkitekt till Arbetsförmedlingen
description:
*Vill du bygga något som gör verklig skillnad? Arbetsförmedlingen söker en lösningsarkitekt som vill vara med och forma Kontrollplattformen – en ny plattform för att motverka felaktiga utbetalningar och välfärdsbrott. Tillsammans får vi Sverige i arbete. Vill du bli en av oss?*




  

  





**Enhetens uppdrag**




 Varje år betalas runt 20 miljarder kronor ut felaktigt från de statliga välfärdssystemen. På sektionen Analys och utredning FUT bygger vi en Kontrollplattform som ska samla Arbetsförmedlingens IT-förmågor att upptäcka och förhindra felaktiga utbetalningar och välfärdsbrott.
   

  





 Grunden i plattformen är en grafdatabas. Både databasen och teamet är under uppbyggnad och du kommer att arbeta nära data engineers, data scientists, DevOps-ingenjörer och riskspecialister i ett tätt tvärfunktionellt samarbete.
   

  





  
   

  





****Beskrivning av tjänsten****




 Som lösningsarkitekt i Kontrollplattformen ansvarar du för hur plattformens IT-lösningar möter verksamhetens behov och följer interna riktlinjer och säkerhetskrav. Du planerar realiseringen utifrån verksamhetens behovsbild och de förutsättningar som befintliga IT-tjänster ger.
   

  





 Kontrollplattformen samverkar med flera av myndighetens system och ska leverera underlag till kontrollutredning och andra verksamhetsprocesser. Gränssnitten mot omgivande system är därför en central del av ditt arbete. Du tar fram systemsambandsbeskrivningar, tjänstegränssnitt och arkitekturriktlinjer, och säkerställer spårbarhet mellan lösningskrav och verksamhetsbehov.
   

  





 I det dagliga arbetet väger du kvalitetsegenskaper som prestanda, skalbarhet, robusthet, förvaltningsbarhet och säkerhet mot funktionella krav, och tar fram underlag för de prioriteringar och kompromisser som behöver göras. Du genomför arkitekturgranskningar, gör bedömningar av realiseringsalternativ – köpa, bygga själv eller en kombination – och ser till att myndighetens riktlinjer följs och att funktionalitet återanvänds där det är tillämpligt. Du samverkar nära områdesarkitekter och enterprisearkitekter för att säkerställa att Kontrollplattformens lösningar hänger ihop med myndighetens övergripande arkitektur.
   

  





 Eftersom plattformen behandlar personuppgifter i en reglerad kontext är informationssäkerhet, dataskydd och rättsliga förutsättningar ständigt närvarande i arkitekturarbetet.
   

  





 Du leder ofta arbetet i olika initiativ och agerar mentor för dem som är inblandade. Du är teamets tekniska ledare och arbetar nära produktägaren i planering och prioritering. Utanför teamet leder du workshops med både verksamhets- och IT-experter, och kan diskutera frågeställningar och motivera val av lösning lika väl med tekniska specialister som med personer utan teknisk bakgrund.
   

  





  
   

  





****Vårt erbjudande****




 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Placeringsorten är
 **Solna** 
 .
   

  





 Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att arbeta på en arbetsplats där vi värdesätter balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Du får tillgång till ett generöst semesteravtal, flexibla arbetstider samt möjlighet att arbeta på distans upp till 49 procent på årsbasis. Hos oss ingår även friskvård under arbetstid och ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag.
   

  





 Som anställd på Arbetsförmedlingen har du också tillgång till kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter inom myndigheten. Genom vårt arbete bidrar vi till ett inkluderande och hållbart samhälle, där du får möjlighet att göra en verklig skillnad för individer och för samhället i stort. 
   

  





 Mer om att jobba hos oss 
   

  





  
   

  





****Grundläggande krav för tjänsten****



* Examen från högskola/universitet inom IT, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande tekniskt område, alternativt erfarenhet och kvalifikationer som bedöms likvärdiga
* Minst 5 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbete som lösningsarkitekt eller motsvarande arkitektroll
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att utforma lösningar som spänner över flera system, inklusive integrationer och API:er
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av dataplattformar och dataflöden (t.ex. ETL/ELT, orkestrering med Dagster eller motsvarande)
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig i svenska i tal och skrift kombinerat med hög läsförståelse
* Goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift



  
   

  





****Övriga meriter för tjänsten****



* Erfarenhet av grafdatabaser och av att modellera domäner där relationer mellan aktörer är centrala
* Erfarenhet av att modellera informationsstrukturer för analys- eller informationsintensiva lösningar, inklusive relationer mellan entiteter
* Erfarenhet av arkitekturarbete i verksamhet med höga krav på informationssäkerhet och dataskydd, t.ex. myndighet eller annan reglerad verksamhet
* Erfarenhet av containerplattformar



  
   

  





 Den statliga värdegrunden guidar oss i vårt dagliga arbete. Som anställd hos oss förväntas du arbeta rättvist, opartiskt och med hög integritet, samt bidra till att upprätthålla och stärka förtroendet för vår myndighet.  
   

  





 Utöver detta har du personlig förmåga och fallenhet att arbeta i enlighet med Arbetsförmedlingens medarbetarkriterier. Läs mer om den statliga värdegrunden och våra medarbetarkriterier på vår hemsida.
   

  





  
   

  





 Som medarbetare på Arbetsförmedlingen förväntas du vara:
   

  





**Ansvarstagande** 
 – ta ansvar för ditt arbete, samarbeta och bidra till en god arbetsmiljö.
   

  





**Handlingskraftig** 
 – ta initiativ, bidra till förbättringar och hantera förändringar.
   

  





**Resultatfokuserad** 
 – planera, följa upp och bidra till verksamhetsnytta och resultat.
   

  





  
   

  





****Ansökan****




 Välkommen med din ansökan senast
 **2026 - 09 - 27** 
 .
   

  





 Bifoga ditt CV där du specificerar årtal, månad och arbetsuppgifter för varje anställning, samt intyg som styrker kraven om utbildning och/eller arbetslivserfarenhet i din ansökan. 
   

  





 Det är viktigt att du besvarar urvalsfrågorna detaljerat och sanningsenligt, för att vi ska få en tydlig bild av din erfarenhet. Om efterfrågad information inte framgår riskerar du bli bortsållad i urvalet. Du behöver inte skicka in ett personligt brev.
   

  





 Under rekryteringsprocessen kan urvalstester förekomma. Vi kommer att hålla dig informerad genom hela rekryteringsprocessen. Mer om vår rekryteringsprocess. 
   

  





 Har du skyddade personuppgifter kontaktar du den rekryteringspartner som finns namngiven i annonsen så får du hjälp med att skicka in din ansökan.
   

  





 Vi arbetar aktivt för att vara en myndighet fri från diskriminering. Det är viktigt för oss att all kompetens tas tillvara och vi välkomnar alla sökande. Vi ser positivt på om du har kunskaper i något av våra nationella minoritetsspråk.
   

  





 Välkommen till oss – vi jobbar för ett Sverige i arbete! Här arbetar du på regeringens uppdrag för en väl fungerande arbetsmarknad. Målet är att korta tiden i arbetslöshet genom att matcha arbetssökande med arbetsgivare. Våra insatser riktas i första hand till dem som står längst ifrån arbetsmarknaden och till de arbetsgivare som är öppna för att anställa dem med störst behov av stöd. Vi motverkar felaktiga utbetalningar och brott mot välfärdssystemen så att våra skattemedel används effektivt till det de är till för. Vi samarbetar med många andra aktörer och tillsammans hittar vi lösningar som gör skillnad - för ett Sverige i arbete.
