title: Business Development Senior Manager - AWS/Data/AI

 **Business Development Senior Manager – AWS/Data/AI** 
 to join our team in
 **Stockholm, Sweden** 
 in a
 **hybrid** 
 working mode.
   

  

 In this role, you will be a key growth driver, responsible for securing AWS-related opportunities across the Nordic market. Your primary focus will be on

 , expanding EPAM’s footprint in strategic industries and deepening collaboration with AWS. This position provides a chance to influence large-scale cloud transformation programs, helping Nordic enterprises adopt cutting-edge AWS solutions to achieve business outcomes.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
   

  

 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
   

  

**About The Role**
 You’ve never been satisfied with just delivering the number. You start by understanding the decision a team is trying to make, then work backwards to the question and evidence they actually need. You earn your seat in the room by making decisions better and helping teams make the next one themselves, whether through a trusted metric, a clearer model, or a self-serve workflow.
   

  

 As an
 **Analytics Engineer** 
 at Tandem you'll own the data layer that the rest of the company runs on - the dbt models, the metrics, the semantic definitions and you'll sit close to the teams that use it. Product deciding what to build next. Clinical ops working out how we serve customers. Commercial and finance running the business. You'll work embedded with them rather than behind a request queue, and you'll be expected to have a point of view and argue it.
   

  

 We are a small but growing data team. It is still early enough that everyone contributes across the full scope of the data team's work. As we grow, this role will likely specialise - likely toward either the product side or the commercial side - and we're open to which of those pulls at you.
   

  

****What You Will Do****
* Turn the questions people bring you into clear, trustworthy answers, delivered in the form and channel they will actually use. Work with stakeholders to see whether the answer was understood, acted on, and changed the decision it was meant to inform.
* Build self-serve surfaces and documentation that help teams answer their own questions and act on what they find.
* Own and evolve the data layer - dbt models, metrics, and semantic definitions - so that the answers built on it are trustworthy and easy to reach for.
* Proactively surface what the data shows - patterns, risks, and opportunities nobody asked about.
* Ensure data and metric quality through testing, monitoring, and clear ownership of the datasets you produce.
* Bring the analytics perspective into data platform decisions: what data, tools, and capabilities we invest in next - and help build them.


****What You Bring****
* Excellent SQL skills.
* Experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, data engineering or a closely related field.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining a modeling layer in production - dbt or equivalent - including testing and documentation.
* A genuinely business-minded approach: you understand what the teams you support are trying to achieve, and you push back when the question they asked isn't the question they need answered.
* Strong communication skills - you can present to a room, explain a method to a non-technical stakeholder, and argue your point without winning by jargon.
* A sense of ownership that extends past delivery: you care whether the work landed.


**Bonus Points**
* Python for analysis, scripting, and lightweight tooling.
* Experience working embedded with product, commercial, or finance teams.
* Experience in healthtech, or in another regulated environment handling sensitive data.
* Experience in early-stage startups or scaleups, where you've built things from close to zero.


**Location**
 We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
   

  

 Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
   

  

* Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
* Interview with a member of the Data team
* Technical discussion and interview with a member of the Data team and our Head of Data
* Case presentation at our office - join us in Stockholm for a case and a lunch with the team, to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with us, and see how you work in action


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary & company stock options
* 30 days/year of paid vacation
* Pension
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)
* Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
* An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
* Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering


 We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.
   

  

**Culture at Tandem**
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
   

  

 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
   

  

 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
   

  

 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
   

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Cyber Defence Expert - Incident Management & Response
description:
**Job Description**
**Solve complex problems. Decode the future.**
 At Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.
   

  

 Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.
   

  

 Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
   

  

**All about the role:**
 We are looking for a highly experienced Cyber Defense Expert to act as a Incident Management and Response subject matter expert while leading the operational maturity and effectiveness of the Security Operations Center. The role is accountable for driving strong incident lifecycle management, from detection, triage, escalation and containment through eradication, recovery, executive communication and lessons learned.
   

  

 You will play a central role in protecting the organization by leading cyber incident response, strengthening SOC effectiveness and improving operational resilience across a global environment. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on how cyber threats are detected, managed, contained and learned from, while helping mature people, processes and technologies that underpin modern cyber defense.
   

  

**What you'll do:**
**Incident Management & Response Leadership**
* Lead end-to-end cyber incident response activities across detection, triage, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery and closure.
* Act as incident commander or senior response lead for high-severity cyber incidents, ensuring clear ownership, decision-making, escalation and communication.
* Design, maintain and continuously improve incident response frameworks, playbooks, severity models, escalation paths and operating procedures.
* Coordinate technical investigations across SOC, infrastructure, cloud, endpoint, identity, network, application and third-party teams.
* Drive post-incident reviews, root cause analysis, corrective actions and measurable improvements to reduce recurrence and improve response effectiveness.


**SOC Leadership & Operational Excellence**
* Lead and mature SOC operations, including alert triage quality, investigation standards, escalation discipline, response workflows and service performance.
* Define and track SOC metrics, SLAs, KPIs and executive reporting related to detection, response, backlog, false positives, incident trends and operational effectiveness.
* Provide operational governance for managed SOC providers, ensuring clear accountability, quality assurance, continuous improvement and alignment with cyber defence objectives.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow or Research Engineer in Robotics and Computer Vision
description:
The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of the largest science and technology infrastructure projects being built today. ESS will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.



ESS is now inviting applications for a Postdoctoral Fellow or Research Engineer in robotics and computer vision to work within the ASTRIND project to conduct research on, develop, and integrate an automated sample alignment system based on robotics and computer vision for the BEER instrument at ESS.


**About the ASTRIND project:**



Funded by the Röntgen-Ångström Cluster, this German-Swedish collaboration aims to enhance strain and texture measurements at ESS’s BEER diffractometer by transferring and extending robotic, vision, and simulation technologies developed at STRESS-SPEC (MLZ Munich). The project will improve alignment, motion planning, and sample exchange through multi-view camera tracking, integrated robot and hexapod control, and a BEER digital twin for calibration, collision-aware trajectory planning, and workflow validation. Additional tools for 3D-based measurement-point selection and in-situ digital image correlation will support advanced experiments. Cross-facility demonstrations between BEER and STRESS-SPEC will establish reproducible, standardized, and higher-throughput engineering diffraction workflows with improved data quality and industrial relevance.


**About the role:**



This position combines robotics, computer vision, software development, and moderate amount of experimental work with neutron diffraction technique to support the development and deployment of advanced sample alignment systems for the BEER instrument.



Your key responsibilities will include:


* Designing the system architecture (robot, cameras, auxiliary equipment) and propose hardware specifications, balancing performance requirements against the ASTRIND budget.
* Leading the integration of the sample robot, cameras, and auxiliary systems with the site-wide integrated control system (EPICS) and the neutron scattering control system (NICOS).
* Defining the data handling and user interfaces required for routine use of automated alignment during experiments.
* Planning and carrying out testing, commissioning, and validation of the system.
* Writing technical documentation


Depending on who we appoint into this position, you may also be:


* Conducting research and supervising master’s students on robotics and computer vision methods for automated sample alignment in neutron scattering applications.
* Publishing these research results in peer-reviewed journals and at conferences to strengthen the scientific output of the project.


This is a grant funded, fixed-term position for a period of three years. The role also requires the flexibility for occasional travel, including visits to project partners in Munich.


**About you:**



To succeed in this role, you need a strong background in robotics, mechatronics, automatic control, computer vision, or a very closely related field. This must be supported by either a PhD or an engineering degree together with relevant professional experience. You are motivated by the opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced instrumentation, software integration, and experimental science within a large-scale international research facility.



You bring solid hands-on experience in robotics and computer vision, including system integration, motion control, sensor or camera systems, and software development for automated or semi-automated platforms. You are comfortable working across both hardware and software layers and enjoy turning complex technical requirements into reliable operational systems.



You have strong programming and software engineering skills, particularly in Python and C/C++, and are confident working in Linux environments, using version control systems such as Git, and developing within frameworks such as ROS. Experience with CAD software and mechanical system design is also expected.



Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:


* Integration of robotic systems with scientific or industrial control systems.
* Machine vision, calibration, or multi-camera tracking systems.
* Motion planning, simulation, or digital twin environments.
* Experimental automation in research or large-scale infrastructure environments.
* EPICS, NICOS, neutron or synchrotron instrumentation, or similar scientific facilities.


For candidates applying at the postdoctoral level, experience of publishing research results and contributing to scientific projects is highly valued. Experience supervising students or mentoring junior colleagues would also be beneficial.



As a person, you are collaborative, proactive, and curious, with a strong interest in learning and developing new skills. You communicate clearly and work effectively with engineers, scientists, software developers, and technical staff from different disciplines and cultural backgrounds. You are comfortable working both independently and as part of an international team, and you have excellent written and spoken English skills.


**To apply:**



A career at ESS gives you the opportunity to contribute to the future discoveries within neutron science at a stunning, brand-new workplace filled with innovative minds and brilliant people from across the globe. We offer individualised compensation which is differentiated according to role, responsibilities, individual skills, abilities and achievements as well as monthly pension contributions on top of your salary.



If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English . Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website. Submit your application as soon as you can and quote the job reference number ESD-82500 in your application.



This role might require enhanced security screening processes, which will be performed during the recruitment process if needed.



For further information about the project please contact Gergely Németh, gergely.nemeth@ess.eu or Karin Rathsman, karin.rathsman@ess.eu. For further information regarding the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Daniel Nordin Baker on Daniel.Nordin@ess.eu



For trade union information, please contact Unionen representative Nerusha Naicker on Nerusha.Naicker@ess.eu or SACO/Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers representative Marc Kickulies at marc.kickulies@ess.eu

Do you want to work in a technically advanced industrial operation within medical technology, where the focus is on electronics development, embedded systems, and quality-driven solutions for wound care and infection prevention technology? We are now looking for an Electronics Engineer with experience in embedded systems and quality control who wants to take a key role in the development, testing, and quality assurance of our electronic medical devices. Sunmedic is a Swedish medical device manufacturer focused on products such as the VivereX™ NPWT system and advanced dressings and foams.
  
The Role
  
In this role, you are responsible for developing, verifying, and quality-assuring the electronics and embedded software in Sunmedic's medical devices, with a particular focus on the VivereX™ NPWT system. You work close to the business and play a key role in ensuring reliable product performance, high quality, and compliance with medical device standards and regulations. The work is carried out in close collaboration with several functions within the organization, including production, quality, regulatory affairs, and maintenance.
  
The role involves both development work and hands-on engagement in testing, troubleshooting, and quality control, with significant scope to influence technical solutions, design choices, and ways of working in order to deliver safe and quality-assured products.

* Design, perform, and document verification and validation testing of electronics and embedded systems
* Be responsible for quality control of electronic components and finished products, including incoming inspection, functional testing, and non-conformance management

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in electronics, electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent

* Experience in quality control, testing, and verification of electronic products, preferably within medical technology or another regulated industry

Sunmedic is a trusted Swedish manufacturer of medical devices focused on advanced wound care solutions. title: Principal Engineer - High growth scale up- Stockholm
description:
**🚀 Principal Engineer role - High Growth scale-up - Stockholm 🚀** 




  





 The title can be interchangeable, but what is a given is that this role is the opportunity to be at the tip-of-the spear within one of Stockholm's most exciting and high-impact startups right now!
 



  





 This role is for someone who wants to be at the forefront of technical discovery, AI application, solving complex, unexplored problems, exploring and spearheading new product & engineering initiatives which translate into real-world commercial impact!
 



  





 You won’t be joining to own a particular engineering team or simply deliver against an existing roadmap. You’ll operate across the organisation, working closely with the CTO, head of product, business leadership and an exceptional product-minded engineering org, to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions and figure out what should be built next!
 



  





**What Makes This Role Different ✅** 




  




* A newly created, foundational position with significant freedom to shape the role and having a transformative impact on a company already leading the pack in its field
* Operating across the organisation rather than within a single engineering team
* Close partnership with senior technology and product leadership
* Exposure to complex technical, product and commercial challenges
* Significant autonomy to explore, experiment and influence direction
* The opportunity to work on problems where there is no obvious playbook
* A position at the intersection of technology, product, AI and business strategy



  





**Your Mission ✅** 




  





 Your role will be to find and solve the problems that sit beyond the boundaries of individual teams.
 



 You’ll have the agency to:
 



  




* Explore complex business and technical challenges
* Identify opportunities where technology can create meaningful new value
* Lead early-stage discovery, experimentation and validation
* Turn promising ideas into prototypes, products or new capabilities
* Challenge existing thinking and introduce new approaches
* Influence technical and product strategy
* Connect engineering capability with wider business opportunities
* Help identify potential new products, markets and revenue streams



  





 The emphasis is on discovery and problem solving rather than execution against a predefined backlog.
 



  





**AI & Emerging Technology ✅** 




  





 AI will be an important part of the role and our strategy going forward, but this is not simply an AI engineering position. You’ll be expected to understand where AI and emerging technologies can genuinely change how the organisation operates, what it builds and how it creates value. AND, be able to decide when AI isn't the solution!
 



  





**This could include: ✅** 




  




* Identifying unconventional opportunities for AI across the business
* Exploring emerging technologies and their practical applications
* Rapidly prototyping new concepts
* Evaluating whether an idea has genuine customer or commercial potential
* Taking successful experiments through to production
* Helping shape the broader technology and AI strategy
* Focusing on measurable outcomes rather than experimentation for its own sake



  





**How You'll Work✅** 



* You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy and work horizontally across engineering, product and business functions.



  




* You should be comfortable moving between high-level business problems and deep technical detail, and knowing when to stay strategic versus when to get hands-on.



  




* You won't be expected to manage a large team. Instead, your impact will come through the problems you solve, the direction you influence and the leverage you create for others.



  





**The Ideal Profile ✅** 




  





 You may currently be a Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, VP of Technology or another senior technical leadership position, a founder trapped within a slow moving enterprise org, or maybe you've been a founding engineer or CTO within a high growth startup!
 



  





**More important than your current title is that you: ✅** 




  




* Have significant experience building software and designing complex systems
* Have operated successfully in high-growth or high-change environments
* Enjoy ambiguity rather than needing a clearly defined scope
* Have experience taking ideas from 0→1
* A track record / examples of taking product/engineering initiatives from idea to launch, getting stakeholder buy in and taking it to production.
* Combine strong technical depth with product and commercial thinking
* Can understand a business problem before jumping to a technical solution
* Have strong architectural judgement and systems thinking
* Are comfortable influencing without formal authority
* Know when to experiment, when to move quickly and when something needs to be built properly
* Are naturally curious about emerging technology and what it could enable



  





**Technology ✅** 




  





 The existing environment includes:
 


* Node.js / TypeScript
* AWS
* MongoDB
* Cloud-native architecture
* Modern engineering practices and tooling



  





 The technology stack is not restrictive. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new technologies where they make sense for the problem being solved.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like ✅** 




  





 Success won't be measured simply by the number of tickets delivered or systems owned.
 



 It will look more like:
 



  




* Complex problems being turned into clear opportunities
* New ideas moving from discovery → prototype → production
* Technology creating measurable new business or product value
* AI being applied in places where it genuinely changes outcomes
* New product or revenue opportunities being identified and validated
* Senior leadership having a trusted technical partner for difficult, ambiguous problems
* The organisation becoming faster and more capable at exploring what comes next



  





 This is a role for someone who wants to be
 **at the frontier of what the organisation could become** 
 , rather than simply maintaining what already exists. Like we mentioned, high ownership, high agency and autonomy, startup ambiguity with an established engineering team and successful product, with a tonne of room to impact!
 



  





 This is a hybrid role, 3 days/week in Stockholm office generally. Unable to assist in Visa sponsorship or extensions at the moment.
 



  





 Compensated with an attractive salary & compensation offering!

* Exposure across multiple SAP modules and domains
* Experience in SAP Sales and Service Delivery roles
* Prior business-domain experience before IT

* Exposure to non-SAP platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft ecosystem)


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong analytical and lateral thinking abilities
* High levels of proactiveness and leadership maturity
* Passion for customer success and long-term relationships
* Strong drive for excellence and quality

title: Senior Game Designer (AI)
description:
**Description & Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 Battlefield is a storied franchise renowned for uncompromising combat gameplay and all-out warfare, for over two decades. 100 million players and 5 billion hours played later, Battlefield Studios is defining the future of the first-person shooter with the biggest launch in franchise history with Battlefield 6, and a new era beginning with Battlefield REDSEC.
   

  

 United under the banner of Battlefield Studios, 4 world-class teams across Criterion, DICE, Motive, and Ripple Effect have come together to focus on the future of the franchise, a connected Battlefield universe filled with immersive experiences built on our unique DNA.
   

  

 LET’S PUSH THINGS FORWARD
   

  

 DICE is a creative studio with offices in Stockholm and Gothenburg. We believe in the power of inclusion and welcome game creators from all backgrounds to collaborate with us as we unlock the potential for the future of Battlefield!
   

  

 We’re always pushing to be at the forefront of creative entertainment - blending digital art, design, and technology to push boundaries. Our collaborative culture is fueled by passion, driving innovation and making a positive difference for our players and community.
   

  

 At DICE, your ideas matter. We offer an inclusive space where you can thrive, be yourself, and grow alongside a team dedicated to making a meaningful impact to the world of gaming.
   

  

 We’re all-in on the future and our most ambitious Battlefield yet. Want to be part of something special? Read on.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Game Designer to create innovative AI systems that enhance player experiences in Battlefield. As part of the core AI team, you will solve complex design challenges and build player-focused systems in a collaborative, cross-disciplinary environment.
   

  

 Focused on PvP across multiplayer and F2P, you will be working as part of a cross studio team, collaborating with colleagues in several countries to deliver high-quality shooter experiences for an established franchise.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing AI systems for games, with a strong portfolio or shipped titles
* Advanced proficiency in game scripting languages such as Blueprints, C#, Lua, or similar
* Deep understanding of current trends in gaming, especially AI/NPC mechanics within the shooter genre
* Excellent documentation skills, with the ability to clearly communicate complex systems and design intent
* Proven ability to design holistic systems where multiple subsystems interact to create compelling gameplay experiences
* Comfortable with iterative design processes, incorporating feedback and refining systems to achieve high quality
* Experience working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams across different locations
* Interest in or knowledge of historical combat and AI systems is a plus


**Qualifications**
 Experience
   

  

* Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in game design, with a focus on game systems and AI design
* Track record of creating games or innovative game concepts, ideally within the shooter genre


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Game Design, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience


 Additional Qualities
   

  

* Genuine passion for the Battlefield franchise and a strong desire to contribute to its ongoing success
* Experience working with behaviour trees
* Player-focused mindset, always designing with the player experience as the top priority
* Proactive in staying up-to-date with industry trends, styles, and emerging technologies in game development


 If you are excited to push the boundaries of AI in games and create unforgettable player experiences, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.
